Position details

Required Skills: We are seeking an experienced Middleware System Administrator / DevOps Engineer to manage, administer, monitor, and support enterprise middleware platforms built on JBoss EAP and integrated with Azure DevOps for source control, CI/CD, and release automation.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in JBoss administration, deployment automation, performance tuning, troubleshooting, clustering, patching, and operational support, along with hands-on experience designing and supporting Azure DevOps pipelines and release processes.

This role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, networking, and DevOps teams to ensure high availability, scalability, operational stability, and continuous improvement of middleware and deployment platforms.

Preferred Skills : Middleware & Web Servers Strong expertise in: JBoss EAP 7/8.x Azure DevOps Experience with: JBoss standalone and domain mode administration JBoss clustering and failover Azure DevOps CI/CD setup and administration Azure Repos, branching strategies, pull requests, and branch policies Azure Pipelines for build, test, deployment, and release automation Azure Artifacts and artifact version management Environment approvals, gates, and release controls mod_jk and mod_cluster configurations Application deployment using GUI and CLI Datasource, JVM, and server configuration management

Responsibilities : Platform Installation & Configuration - Provision, install, configure, monitor, and administer JBoss EAP environments across development, QA, staging, and production. Configure and support JBoss clustering and failover for high availability in both standalone and domain modes.

Configure, administer, and troubleshoot integrations with enterprise application components and systems.

Ensure reliable routing, session handling, resiliency, and failover across web and application tiers. Configure and manage Azure DevOps integrations with JBoss for automated application deployment.

Troubleshoot and support mod_jk and mod_cluster integrations with JBoss web servers.

Deployment & Release Operations

  • Manage deployment workflows in Azure DevOps, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, release tagging, approvals, and access control.

Configure and support Azure Pipelines, including automated builds, deployments, artifact management, test execution, and environment promotions. Package and deploy enterprise applications (WAR/EAR) to JBoss EAP using GUI and CLI tools.

Execute deployments in standalone and domain mode configurations, including rolling deployments to server groups for high availability.

Perform post-deployment validation activities including smoke testing, log analysis, health checks, and performance and availability verification.

Develop and maintain rollback procedures, deployment runbooks, operational checklists, and release documentation.

Participate in change management, deployment reviews, and post-release stabilization activities.

Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management - Perform day-to-day middleware administration and operational support activities Troubleshoot issues related to authentication, authorization, login failures, web content delivery, web server behavior, and JBoss runtime/application issues Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and health check mechanisms to minimize production incidents Analyze operational trends and system performance metrics to improve platform reliability Generate operational reports and maintain technical and monitoring documentation Monitor production applications and recommend incident prevention and resolution improvements Patch, Upgrade & Configuration Management Plan, coordinate, and execute JBoss EAP upgrades, fix packs, and patching activities Perform regular OS and middleware patching using automation tools and approved maintenance windows Maintain environment baselines, standards, and configuration documentation Create upgrade and patch implementation plans and coordinate execution across multiple teams Performance Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Perform performance tuning of JVM heap and GC settings, thread pools, datasource connection pools, caching configurations, and web server configurations. Analyze thread dumps, heap dumps, and server logs to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.

Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions. Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve application performance and stability issues.

Coordinate with vendors and raise support tickets for product-related issues when necessary.

Automation & Scripting - Automate repetitive middleware administration and maintenance tasks to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

Develop and maintain Shell/Bash scripts for health checks, log maintenance, housekeeping, deployments, validation activities, and scheduled operational tasks.

Capacity Planning & Reliability - Monitor system utilization and perform capacity planning for growth and performance stability.

Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and recommend scaling and tuning improvements.

Support resiliency and availability initiatives for enterprise middleware environments.

Collaboration & Documentation - Collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, networking, and application support teams to resolve operational issues.

Maintain detailed technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.

Provide technical guidance and training to support teams where required. Demonstrate ownership, initiative, and the ability to manage competing priorities and operational deadlines.

raw.description:
Are you excited by the opportunity to mentor journalists, shape editorial strategy, and drive excellence across award-winning data-driven reporting?

Do you enjoy uncovering meaningful stories in complex datasets and turning them into journalism that informs and engages readers?

About our Team

Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.

About the Role

Law360 is seeking an Assistant Managing Editor to lead the editorial side of our data team – overseeing reporters, editors and research specialists who turn data into compelling, rigorous journalism and making sure our data-driven series are reported, written, edited and produced to the highest standards.

This is a hands-on editorial leadership role. The AME will shape story ideas, coach reporters and editors, and own the quality of everything the team publishes, from recurring data series to one-off investigative pieces. The AME will work closely with graphics, research and survey analysts to make sure the numbers behind our stories are sound and the storytelling around them is clear and engaging.

The AME will also help develop new data-driven series, identify datasets worth building, and help guide and shape surveys and research that are topical and genuinely relevant to our audience. We're looking for someone who can look at a dataset and see the stories that readers will care about.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of data reporters and editors, setting clear standards for reporting, writing and production across our data-driven series.

  • Ensure data journalism is edited for accuracy, clarity, fairness and narrative strength – making sure complex numbers translate into stories readers can actually use.

  • Develop and pitch story and series ideas, and guide projects from concept through publication in collaboration with reporters, editors and graphics staff.

  • Coach and develop reporters and editors, helping them sharpen both their data skills and their writing.

  • Own the editorial quality and integrity of the team's output, including how data and statistical findings are interpreted and presented.

  • Partner with survey and research specialists to make sure reporting is accurate, well-sourced and clearly explained.

  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration so stories publish on time and meet the highest standards.

Requirements

  • 7-10+ years of relevant experience in newsrooms, with a strong track record in data-driven or investigative reporting and editing

  • Demonstrated leadership or team management experience in a newsroom

  • Sharp editorial judgment and strong editing skills, especially with data-heavy stories

  • Comfort working with data of varying quality and completeness, and the ability to spot when the numbers don't add up

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams

Preferences

  • Experience editing or producing recurring data series or investigative projects

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as R or Python

  • Experience with data visualization techniques

  • Legal industry reporting or research experience

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Degree in journalism, public policy, political science, economics, statistics or a related field

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

The Opportunity:

The Cybersecurity Architect is responsible for designing, reviewing, and advancing security architecture across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, identity services, networks, and data environments. This hands-on technical role partners with engineering, infrastructure, product, and business teams to ensure security is integrated throughout the technology lifecycle. The Cybersecurity Architect develops threat models, conducts architecture and design reviews, and applies secure-by-design principles to support the organization's cybersecurity strategy.

This role translates business objectives and regulatory requirements, including HIPAA, HITRUST, and NIST Cybersecurity Framework requirements, into practical architectural solutions and security controls. The Cybersecurity Architect serves as a trusted advisor to technology teams, helping to ensure that solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with organizational standards and regulatory obligations. The position reports to the Director of Cybersecurity and functions as an individual contributor.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Design and review security architectures for cloud, infrastructure, application, identity, network, and data environments using secure-by-default principles and established security patterns.
  • Develop and maintain threat models for assigned systems, identifying attack surfaces, security risks, and recommended mitigations.
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing security guidance and recommendations to project and engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the cybersecurity architecture roadmap and evaluate emerging technologies to support future-state security initiatives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on security architecture for engineering, infrastructure, and product teams.
  • Promote and support zero-trust security principles, least-privilege access models, and defense-in-depth strategies across enterprise systems.
  • Mentor engineers and technical teams on secure design practices and adherence to approved security standards and patterns.
  • Translate regulatory and security framework requirements, including HIPAA, HITRUST, and NIST CSF, into technical architecture requirements and control mappings.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) teams to ensure solutions meet internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct risk assessments and develop architecture recommendations, remediation strategies, and mitigation plans for leadership review.
  • Act as a liaison between cybersecurity, infrastructure, application development, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide security architecture consultation for new technology initiatives, projects, and third-party vendor integrations.
  • Support customer security reviews and third-party due diligence activities by articulating architecture decisions and validating security controls.
  • Partner with cybersecurity analysts, engineers, and architects to ensure effective security controls are implemented across enterprise systems, cloud platforms, and applications.

Employment Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5 to 8 years of overall information security experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a cybersecurity or security architecture role.
  • Experience designing and securing cloud, application, infrastructure, and data environments.(Role requirement inferred directly from documented responsibilities.)
  • Experience conducting threat modeling, architectural reviews, and security risk assessments.
  • Experience working within regulated environments and supporting compliance requirements such as HIPAA, HITRUST, and NIST CSF.

Preferred Certifications:

  • One or more of the following certifications is preferred:
  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
  • AWS Certified Security – Specialty
  • Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
  • Equivalent cloud security or architecture certification

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Security architecture design and review methodologies.
  • Threat modeling, attack surface analysis, and risk assessment.
  • Cloud security architecture across AWS and Azure environments.
  • Secure application, infrastructure, network, identity, and data architecture principles.
  • Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth security strategies.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST CSF, and healthcare security requirements.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate technical security requirements into business-focused recommendations.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams and mentor technical staff on secure design practices.
  • Experience collaborating across cybersecurity, engineering, privacy, compliance, legal, and business organizations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.
  • This position pays between $163,700-$245,500 based on experience

Overview of Position

The Senior Real Estate & Facilities Analyst supports the Global Corporate Real Estate organization by transforming complex portfolio, financial, occupancy, lease, project, facilities, workplace, sustainability, and employee data into accurate reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support materials.

This role combines advanced analytics, data governance, business intelligence, technology enablement, and practical artificial intelligence capabilities with strong corporate real estate knowledge. The analyst develops dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, scenario models, business cases, and executive presentations that support portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, capital investment, lease decisions, operational improvement, and long-term planning.

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to communicate complex findings clearly to executive, financial, operational, and technical audiences while partnering effectively across functions and with external service providers.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Data Analytics, Governance & Portfolio Analysis (25%)

  • Collect, cleanse, reconcile, validate, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external systems.

  • Maintain data standards, definitions, ownership, validation procedures, business rules, quality controls, and documentation across Corporate Real Estate data sources.

  • Monitor data quality, identify discrepancies and root causes, and coordinate remediation with internal teams and external service providers.

  • Analyze occupancy cost, utilization, lease activity, facilities operations, capital projects, sustainability, workplace experience, employee work arrangements, and portfolio risk.

  • Develop key performance indicators, benchmarks, forecasts, trends, scenario models, and ad hoc analyses to support portfolio optimization, site consolidation, workplace strategy, lease decisions, and capital investment.

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Technology (25%)

  • Build, manage, and continuously enhance centralized dashboards, scorecards, reporting tools, and analytical platforms for site-level and consolidated portfolio reporting.

raw.title: Environmental Chemist/Data Validator
raw.excerpt: Leidos is seeking a Senior Environmental Chemist to support federal environmental remediation and restoration programs for multiple government clients.
raw.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Environmental Chemist to support federal environmental remediation and restoration programs for multiple government clients. This position will provide senior-level technical expertise in environmental chemistry, chemical data validation, data quality, and environmental data management in support of site characterization, remediation, environmental compliance, waste disposal, and restoration activities.


The Senior Environmental Chemist will oversee the validation and management of inorganic and organic analytical data, including PFAS and other emerging contaminants; provide technical oversight of analytical laboratory subcontractors; and ensure environmental data meet applicable project, regulatory, and quality assurance requirements. The position will also provide technical guidance and oversight to junior and mid-level chemists performing data validation activities.

This role will manage environmental sample and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle, from sampling preparation and laboratory coordination through data validation, database management, usability assessment, and final reporting.

This is a remote, office-based position and does not involve routine laboratory bench work.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform chemical data validation and independent technical reviews of inorganic and organic analytical laboratory data packages.
  • Evaluate laboratory deliverables for completeness and compliance, assess quality control results, and assign appropriate data validation qualifiers based on applicable criteria.
  • Oversee and review Stage 2 data validation performed by junior and mid-level chemists.
  • Prepare data validation narratives, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) reports, and data usability assessments documenting findings and conclusions.
  • Author, review, and implement Uniform Federal Policy Quality Assurance Project Plans (UFP-QAPPs) and associated quality assurance documentation.
  • Support environmental field sampling activities through database setup, sample identification, labels, chain-of-custody documentation, and review for compliance with project planning documents.
  • Manage environmental samples and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle using applicable environmental data management systems.
  • Perform quality control reviews of data entered into environmental databases, including EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and FUDSChem.
  • Query, evaluate, and reconcile environmental data in response to project needs and verify final database information against laboratory-reported results.
  • Manage analytical laboratory subcontractors, coordinate sample delivery and analytical schedules, review laboratory performance, and resolve laboratory QA/QC deficiencies.
  • Coordinate closely with project managers, environmental scientists, engineers, field personnel, laboratories, and data management staff to meet project requirements and schedules.
  • Provide technical guidance to project managers and junior staff regarding analytical chemistry, laboratory methods, data quality, validation requirements, and interpretation of chemical data.
  • Support environmental investigations, site characterization, remediation, environmental permitting, effluent monitoring, waste characterization and disposal, and other environmental restoration activities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a closely related scientific discipline and at least 10 years of relevant experience in environmental chemistry, including validation of inorganic and organic analytical data and environmental data/database management.
  • Demonstrated experience validating analytical data for environmental investigation, remediation, restoration, or compliance programs.
  • Experience with PFAS analytical data and other emerging contaminants.
  • Experience overseeing and providing technical review of junior and mid-level chemists performing Stage 2 data validation.
  • Strong working knowledge of EPA SW-846 methods, Contract Laboratory Program (CLP) requirements, and environmental analytical chemistry methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate laboratory QA/QC results and determine the usability and quality of environmental analytical data.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage responsibilities across multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing or reviewing Stage 3 and/or Stage 4 data validation.
  • Working knowledge of the Department of Defense (DoD) Quality Systems Manual (QSM) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) National Functional Guidelines for Data Review.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing UFP-QAPPs for federal environmental programs.
  • Experience supporting CERCLA, RCRA, DoD, USACE, EPA, or other federal environmental remediation/restoration programs.
  • Experience with environmental data management systems such as EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and/or FUDSChem.
  • Experience with database and data management tools such as Microsoft Access and SQL.
  • Experience managing analytical laboratory subcontractors and resolving laboratory data quality or performance issues.

Must be able to pass a Public Trust background investigation; due to contract requirements, U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent residency is required.

**Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.**

raw.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
raw.excerpt: Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with.
raw.description:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do

  • Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
  • Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
  • Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
  • Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
  • Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
  • Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

  • You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
  • High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
  • Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
  • Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
  • Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level

  • 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
  • Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
  • Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
  • Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.

SUMMARY

As the Global Project Manager you will be accountable for delivering an assigned portfolio of global studies to time, cost, and quality, acting as the day-to-day client point of contact for those studies. You will work closely with in-country delivery teams to plan, track, and drive study execution, applying the methodology, baselines, and KPIs and keeping study-level performance reporting accurate and current. This is a hands-on, operational project-management role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Study Delivery — Time, Cost & Quality

  • Manage assigned global studies end to end across start-up, recruitment, execution, and close-out

  • Maintain study timelines, budgets, and resource plans, tracking progress against approved baselines

  • Identify risks and issues early, propose mitigation and recovery actions, and escalate to the Global Study Delivery Lead where they exceed delegated authority

  • Monitor study budgets and variance, and support change-order and invoicing activity

Client Communication

  • Serve as the day-to-day client contact for assigned studies, with escalation support from the Global Study Delivery Lead

  • Prepare and deliver regular study status updates — progress, risks, variance, and recovery actions

  • Track client commitments and action items through to closure

  • Contribute to a consistently positive client experience that supports repeat work

Project-Management Practice

  • Apply Civia’s study delivery and project-management methodology, templates, and tools consistently

  • Maintain study plans, risk and issue logs, and decision records to the required standard

  • Run study kick-off, team, and client meetings with clear agendas, minutes, and actions

  • Follow up with internal functions to secure their contributions to study commitments

  • Support onboarding and informal mentoring of less experienced delivery colleagues

In-Country & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work day to day with in-country delivery teams to align on priorities, timelines, and responsibilities for each assigned study

  • Coordinate Site Operations, Recruitment, Regulatory, Data, Quality, and Safety input to deliver each study to plan

  • Prepare for and take part in study-level delivery reviews, driving timely resolution of bottlenecks

  • Make sure each country team and function knows what it owns, and by when, on assigned studies

  • Escalate constructively when delivery performance deviates from plan

Planning, Tracking & Reporting

  • Build and maintain study plans in line with Civia’s delivery methodology

  • Set up and maintain study baselines and forecasts using the agreed models

  • Track and report study KPIs using the established KPI framework

  • Keep study data in CRIO, HubSpot, Monday.com, and related systems accurate and current

  • Provide feedback on methodology, templates, and tools based on study experience

Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Follow the governance routines and performance cadence set for the portfolio

  • Maintain audit and inspection readiness on assigned studies

  • Implement corrective and preventive actions on assigned studies and track them to closure

  • Capture lessons learned at study milestones and close-out, and share them with the delivery team

Education and Experience:

Required Experience

  • 5–8 years of clinical research experience, including at least 3 years managing clinical trials (global or multi-country preferred)

  • B.S. or B.A.; science-related degree preferred. Project-management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) advantageous.

  • Track record of delivering studies to time, cost, and quality

  • Working knowledge of project-management methods and tools

  • Sound understanding of ICH-GCP, GDPR, and relevant regulatory requirements

  • Good analytical and financial skills — able to manage study budgets, forecasts, and KPIs

  • Experience with CRIO, HubSpot, and Monday.com, or comparable platforms

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
About Scale Media

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition and Amazon teams across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.

This is a senior role, but not a pure strategy role. We need someone with deep platform expertise who is in the data every day, managing performance with the team and raising the bar on media buying. We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers, so strong Meta experience is essential, and you'll lead performance across every paid channel.

On top of daily performance, you'll work with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, decide what signal we send to every channel, and help shape how paid media supports retention. DTC paid media drives significant halo to Amazon, so you'll lead Amazon alongside DTC and manage how the two work together.

You'll partner closely with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and report to the VP of Growth.

What You'll Own

  • Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands, channels, and Amazon, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.
  • Leading the paid acquisition and Amazon teams. Managing and developing both teams, raising the bar on media buying, and building the next layer of leaders.
  • Cross-channel strategy and budget allocation. Deciding where the next dollar goes across brands, product lines, and channels (Google, Meta, Bing, others).
  • Unit economics and targets. Working with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, and holding acquisition to them.
  • Signal strategy. Deciding what signal we send to each platform, such as value-based bidding, LTV- or margin-weighted conversions, and offline events, and making sure it's implemented correctly.
  • Amazon. Leading the Amazon channel and measuring and managing the halo between DTC paid media and Amazon sales.
  • Paid media and retention. Shaping how paid media supports retention, including existing-customer suppression, win-back, and new vs. returning customer reporting by channel.
  • Measurement. Working with Analytics and our measurement partners (MTA, lift testing, MMM) to continuously improve how we decide where to allocate budget.
  • Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across channels, tactics, offers, and landing pages, and knowing which results to scale and which to cut.
  • AI-enabled workflows. Driving the use of AI tools and automation across acquisition to speed up reporting, analysis, and optimization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level LTV/CAC and MER targets
  • Scaled paid media spend across channels and brands
  • A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
  • A media buying team that's measurably stronger and makes better decisions on its own
  • Budget allocation driven by marginal returns and incrementality, not platform-reported ROAS
  • Platform signal that steers bidding toward higher-value customers
  • A measured view of DTC-to-Amazon halo that shapes how we invest across both
  • Paid media and retention working together, with clean new vs. returning customer reporting

What We're Looking For

  • Deep platform expertise. You've led 8-figure Meta and paid social spend, can diagnose an account yourself, have a playbook for scaling without losing efficiency that adapts as platforms evolve, and know the major platforms well enough to challenge your team's decisions.
  • Drive to be in the numbers every day. Seniority hasn't taken you out of the data. You review performance daily, notice when something moves, and work with the team until you understand and address it.
  • People leadership. You've managed media buying teams, developed strong buyers into leaders, and raised the bar through others.
  • Cross-channel ownership. You've owned budget and performance across multiple paid channels for consumer brands.
  • Unit economics depth. You've set or materially shaped LTV/CAC, payback, or MER targets and know how to translate them into channel and product-line targets.
  • Measurement sophistication. You understand MTA, lift testing, and MMM, the limits of each, and how to use them together to make budget decisions.
  • Signal and data strategy. You've improved platform optimization through better conversion signal, such as value-based bidding, Conversions API enrichment, or offline conversions.
  • Marketplace understanding. You understand how paid media drives Amazon sales and how to measure and plan for that halo.
  • Cross-functional influence. You work well with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and can align them around shared targets.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including managing teams and owning multi-channel budgets.

Strong candidate backgrounds include:

  • Heads of growth or acquisition at scaled DTC brands who still run performance day to day
  • Directors who have owned multi-channel budgets and are ready for broader scope
  • Agency leaders who've run performance for large, multi-channel ecommerce clients

Preferred, but Not Required

  • Hands-on Amazon Ads or marketplace experience
  • Experience with retention or CRM programs
  • Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses
  • Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios

What We Offer

  • Salary: $200,000 - $300,000 depending on experience
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous Paid Time Off program
  • Discounted Products

raw.description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:

The Sr MSL role will represent the real time voice of KOL/HCP input related product development opportunities and scientific exchange on pipeline and commercial products; conduct clinical presentations to payer organizations. The ideal candidate will be a strong leader with a proven ability to leverage their high scientific acumen to engaged and educate on scientifically complex concepts and products. The preferred candidate will also have a proven strategic and innovative style combined with a flexible, hands-on nature that works with a high sense of urgency.

Position Responsibilities

  • Become a SMA and apitegromab medical/clinical/scientific expert
  • Build and foster relationships with local, regional, and national KOLs and possibly Payers
  • Effectively deliver medical/clinical/scientific presentations to a diverse external audience

  • Contribute to developing metrics, qualitative and quantitative MSL reports, SOPs/Business Practices for the MSL function

  • Co-create and deliver the MSL training

  • Contribute to the development of the Global and US Medical Plans for apitegromab in SMA
  • May be asked to participate in Advisory Board meeting, Advisory Group meetings, speaker trainings, etc.
  • Coordinate local and regional investigator-initiated research (IIR)
  • Compliantly manage IIR milestones and objectives
  • Report on scientific sessions and conduct scientific exchange to unsolicited questions at SRRK medical booths at congresses

  • Conduct all activities and responsibilities in accordance with all relevant legal, regulatory and corporate regulations and guidelines, including the Scholar Rock Business Conduct & Ethics, policies and procedures

Candidate Requirements

  • MD, PharmD, or PhD preferred. Advanced professional degree (NP, PT etc) may be considered for candidates with significant clinical neuromuscular disease experience
  • Neurology and/or rare disease experience with prior launch experience preferred

raw.excerpt: We are hiring for the Head of Financial Planning & Analysis, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team.
raw.description:
We are hiring for the Head of Financial Planning & Analysis, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.

Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.

Location: This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.

The role entails

  • Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations
  • Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment
  • Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives
  • Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence
  • Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning
  • Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.
  • Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting
  • Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings
  • Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team
  • Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams
  • Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth
  • Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character
  • Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools
  • Understanding of core accounting principles
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments
  • International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience
  • Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis
  • Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Bi-annual compensation review
  • Company recognition rewards
  • 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.excerpt: OpportunitéÀ Valtech, vous trouverez un environnement propice à l’apprentissage continu, à l’impact concret et à la croissance professionnelle.
raw.description:
Opportunité

À Valtech, vous trouverez un environnement propice à l’apprentissage continu, à l’impact concret et à la croissance professionnelle. Que vous développiez de nouvelles solutions digitales, remettiez en question les idées reçues ou construisiez la prochaine génération d’expériences client, votre travail contribuera à transformer les secteurs d'activité.

Nous sommes fiers de:

  • Notre travail et l'innovation que nous encourageons
  • Nos valeurs : « share, dare, care »
  • Une culture d'entreprise qui favorise la créativité, la diversité et l'autonomie
  • Notre structure mondiale sans frontières, qui permetune collaboration fluide

La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise, car le rôle implique des communications régulières avec des clients et des collègues situés à l'extérieur du Québec.

Rôle

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur technique visionnaire et opérationnel(le) pour rejoindre notre practice Cloud & DevOps au Canada. Ce rôle de leadership senior combine une expertise technique approfondie, du conseil stratégique, de l’architecture de solutions et du leadership en matière de delivery, afin d’aider nos clients à moderniser leurs plateformes, à accélérer la livraison de logiciels et à créer de la valeur grâce aux technologies cloud-native et aux solutions basées sur l’IA.

Le profil idéal possède une solide expérience de Microsoft Azure, des architectures modernes d’applications web, notamment Next.js, ainsi que des technologies émergentes d’IA agentique (Agentic AI). Vous accompagnerez des initiatives de transformation d’entreprise, contribuerez à définir la stratégie technique, accompagnerez les équipes d’ingénierie et collaborerez avec les parties prenantes métiers afin de développer et déployer des solutions innovantes à grande échelle.

Responsabilités du poste

Leadership technique
Définir et piloter la vision technique, les stratégies d’architecture et les bonnes pratiques pour les projets Cloud et DevOps.
Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions cloud-native à grande échelle sur Microsoft Azure.
Établir les standards d’ingénierie, les cadres de gouvernance, les contrôles de sécurité et les pratiques d’excellence opérationnelle.
Agir comme conseiller(ère) de confiance auprès des dirigeants, des responsables technologiques et des équipes produit des clients.
IA agentique et innovation
Diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA agentique utilisant des frameworks modernes d’orchestration de l’IA, des LLM, des copilotes, des workflows autonomes et des agents intelligents.
Accompagner les clients dans l’identification des opportunités d’automatisation de processus métiers complexes grâce à des systèmes basés sur l’IA.
Évaluer les technologies émergentes en matière d’IA et définir des stratégies d’adoption alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise.
Concevoir des solutions d’IA sécurisées, évolutives et responsables au sein d’environnements d’entreprise.
Excellence Cloud & DevOps
Piloter les initiatives d’adoption du cloud, de modernisation, de migration et de platform engineering.
Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD, de l’Infrastructure as Code (IaC), des pratiques d’observabilité, de reliability engineering et de gouvernance cloud.
Accompagner les équipes plateforme dans la mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels DevOps évolutifs et de stratégies d’automatisation.
Veiller à ce que les solutions répondent aux exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de performance et de fiabilité.
Delivery et relation client
Diriger des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires sur plusieurs projets.
Participer aux activités de prévente, de conception de solutions, aux ateliers de découverte technique et à la préparation de propositions.
Assurer une communication de niveau exécutif et un leadership technique tout au long de la réalisation des projets.
Gérer les risques techniques, les décisions d’architecture et la qualité des livrables.
Développement des talents
Accompagner et encadrer les architectes, ingénieurs et responsables techniques.
Favoriser une culture d’innovation, d’amélioration continue et d’excellence technique.
Contribuer au développement des compétences et des capacités au sein de la practice Cloud & DevOps.

Qualifications requises

Afin d’être éligible à ce poste, vous devez posséder les qualifications essentielles suivantes:

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en software engineering, architecture cloud, platform engineering ou DevOps.

  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions de leadership technique, d’architecture ou de conseil.

  • Expertise approfondie de Microsoft Azure, notamment des services Azure, des patterns d’architecture, de la gouvernance, de la sécurité et des opérations.

  • Solide expérience dans la conception et la livraison d’applications d’entreprise utilisant Next.js, React et des architectures web modernes.

  • Expérience démontrée dans la mise en œuvre ou l’architecture de solutions d’IA agentique, d’automatisation basée sur l’IA, de workflows autonomes, de copilotes ou de frameworks avancés de solutions IA.

  • Expérience des architectures cloud-native, des microservices, des API, des conteneurs et des systèmes distribués.

  • Solide expérience en conseil auprès de clients et en gestion de parties prenantes au niveau exécutif.

  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Azure : App Services, AKS, Functions, AI Services, Networking, Security, Identity, Data Services et capacités de Platform Engineering.

  • Maîtrise des plateformes et pratiques DevOps, notamment GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code et automatisation.

  • Expérience des technologies de conteneurisation et d’orchestration telles que Docker et Kubernetes.

  • Bonne connaissance des écosystèmes modernes JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Expérience en observabilité, monitoring, reliability engineering et bonnes pratiques de sécurité cloud.

  • Expérience de l’intégration de solutions d’IA et de machine learning dans des applications d’entreprise.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Certification Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert ou autre certification Microsoft pertinente.

  • Expérience avec Azure OpenAI Service et la mise en œuvre de plateformes IA en environnement d’entreprise.

  • Expérience en platform engineering et en plateformes internes pour développeurs (Internal Developer Platforms).

  • Expérience dans des environnements de conseil, de transformation numérique ou d’intégration de systèmes.

  • Expérience dans la direction d’équipes de delivery distribuées et internationales.

Si vous ne possédez pas toutes les qualifications mentionnées ou si vous avez des lacunes dans votre parcours, nous vous encourageons à postuler. À Valtech, nous reconnaissons la richesse des talents et valorisons la pluralité des perspectives ainsi que la soif d’apprendre.

Engagement pour l’inclusion

Nous concevons des expériences qui conviennent à toutes les personnes — et cela commence par nos équipes. À Valtech, nous avons à cœur de bâtir une culture inclusive où chaque individu se sent soutenu pour grandir, s'épanouir et atteindre ses objectifs. Quel que soit votre parcours, vous avez votre place. Explorez notre site Diversité et Inclusion pour en savoir plus sur nos actions en faveur d’un Valtech plus équitable.

Bénéfices et avantages

Il s’agit d’un poste Temporaire de 4 mois basé au Canada. La fourchette salariale proposée est de CAD $ 90-98 de l'heure, selon l’expérience et la localisation.

Processus de recrutement

Une fois votre candidature envoyée, notre équipe Talent Acquisition l’examinera sous quelques jours. Si vos compétences et votre expérience correspondent au poste, nous vous contacterons pour les prochaines étapes.

⚠️ Attention aux fraudes : n’interagissez qu’avec des adresses e-mail officielles se terminant par @valtech.com.

Nous nous engageons en faveur de l’inclusion et de l’accessibilité. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement raisonnable pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez l’indiquer dans votre candidature ou en informer votre Talent Partner.

À propos de Valtech

Valtech est une entreprise d’innovation et d’expérience qui a pour vocation d’offrir une meilleure façon d'appréhender le monde. En combinant expertises, secteurs et cultures, nous aidons les marques à créer de la valeur dans un monde de plus en plus digital.

À l’intersection des données, de l’IA, de la créativité et de la technologie, nous accompagnons la transformation de grandes entreprises telles que L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, et bien d’autres.

À Valtech, la transformation ne se limite pas aux discours. Nous la concrétisons. Nos collaborateurs sont au cœur de notre succès, et nous cultivons un environnement où chaque talent peut s’épanouir, évoluer et innover.

Prêt·e à imaginer la suite ? Rejoignez-nous.

Conformément à la loi allemande sur l'égalité de traitement et à son équivalent français, les offres d'emploi doivent être publiées de manière non sexiste. Nous utilisons la mention pour préciser que ce poste est ouvert à tous les genres dans ces pays, même si le titre du poste lui-même peut être traduit ou interprété comme « masculin » en allemand ou en français.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

raw.description:
Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

Locker per chiavi, supportato da una rete globale di oltre 7.000 esercizi commerciali locali che custodiscono le chiavi per host Airbnb, agenzie immobiliari e autonoleggi.

Allora questo ruolo fa per te!

description: This is not a marketing role.  It's the operational engine behind three very different consumer brands in personal care, home goods, and better-for-you food.

raw.title: Brand Operations Associate (DTC, Subscription & Amazon)
raw.excerpt: This is not a marketing role.  It's the operational engine behind three very different consumer brands in personal care, home goods, and better-for-you food.
raw.description:
This is not a marketing role. It's the operational engine behind three very different consumer brands in personal care, home goods, and better-for-you food. You'll own the systems, reporting, inventory planning, and cross-channel coordination that keep the brands running every day across DTC (Shopify), subscription, and Amazon.

Think of it as the #2 seat on a small, fast-moving brand team. You'll keep operations tight, flag risks before they become problems, and free up the Brand Manager to focus on high-leverage decisions. You won't be siloed on one brand. You'll go wherever the portfolio needs operational horsepower most, so you'll learn in one year what usually takes three.

What You'll Do

Inventory & Operations

  • Own inventory tracking, demand planning, and reorder cadence across DTC, subscription, and Amazon
  • Coordinate with suppliers, co-packers, and 3PLs to keep stock flowing and SKUs healthy
  • Build and maintain daily/weekly reports on sales, performance, and forecasts
  • Spot risks early and keep the Brand Manager informed

Subscription Operations

  • Support recurring-revenue operations: cadence, swaps, and upcoming-order management
  • Forecast subscription and one-time demand together so stock covers both
  • Report on active subscribers, churn, and retention

Amazon

  • Run day-to-day Seller Central / Vendor Central operations: listings, inventory, and case management
  • Monitor Buy Box, listing health, reviews, and account performance
  • Support advertising operations, promotions, and FBA inbound planning

Project Management & Marketing Support

  • Own task management and coordination across multiple brands at once
  • Help plan and execute product launches and campaigns
  • Coordinate influencer partnerships, draft social/email content and creative briefs, and QA landing pages and ads

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in operations, supply chain, or logistics, ideally at a consumer brand, 3PL, or manufacturer
  • Real inventory experience: reorder points, lead times, safety stock, sell-through, SKU-level health
  • Demand planning skills: building forecasts, sizing POs, balancing stock across channels
  • Experience managing vendors such as suppliers, co-packers, 3PLs, or freight forwarders
  • Comfort with ops systems: inventory platforms (Cin7, NetSuite, or similar), 3PL portals, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, subscription tools (Recharge, Skio, or similar), and heavy spreadsheet work
  • Strong written and verbal English
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-directed. You see what needs to happen and you do it
  • Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously across more than one brand at a time

Benefits

  • A real seat at the table. You'll do meaningful work with visibility, not busywork.
  • Three businesses, not one. You'll get broad, fast learning across very different categories.
  • Early-stage opportunity. If you join now, you'll grow with the platform and get opportunities that won't exist later.

raw.description:
Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. (NASDAQ:OCUL) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the formulation, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for diseases and conditions of the eye using its proprietary bioresorbable hydrogel-based formulation technology, ELUTYX™. Ocular Therapeutix has built a robust product pipeline of drug delivery solutions developed to reduce the complexity and burden of the current standard of care and position itself to become a leader in the ophthalmic space.

Outside of the ophthalmic realm and behind the doors of our headquarters in Bedford, MA, we strive to build a strong culture where employees can flourish and achieve their career goals. We encourage out of the box thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and creativity.

Position Summary:

As the ED/VP of Patient and Provider Support, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless access to our products and delivering an excellent provider and patient experience. Your primary focus will be to set national patient access and reimbursement strategies, lead large field-based teams and remove access barriers for our specialty pharmaceutical products. You'll be instrumental in building capabilities from the ground up and ensure launch-ready infrastructure for our upcoming launch in Retina. The role will collaborate internally across Market Access, Corp. Accounts, Trade & Distribution, Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations / Analytics, Training, Finance, Legal / Compliance and Human Resources. A strong track record of building scalable capabilities to support future growth and operating in a launch readiness setting is expected.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Strategy: Design and execute long-term provider reimbursement, patient access, adherence and hub program strategies for the existing portfolio and new launches. Assess the current Retina landscape and identify opportunities to innovate provider and patient solutions
  • Team management: Lead and scale a team of Field Reimbursement Directors and Managers as well as Patient Services Hub Operations and case managers
  • Provider reimbursement support: Develop go-to-market strategy for FRM team.Oversee all marketing, tools and support systems developed to ease reimbursement workflows for providers. Ensure tight coordination between Corporate Account teams and FRM team to pull through reimbursement tools / solutions within child accounts and address any issues
  • Patient services and support: Oversee internal and third-party operations, maximize data analytics and service delivery to patients and caregivers
  • Policy & Payer expertise: Monitor changing federal, state and commercial payer policies, billing codes and buy-and-bill dynamics and suggest strategies to improve performance as needed
  • Cross-functional leadership: Key partner with brand leadership to align on FRM account prioritization. Oversee local-level partnership with sales, corp. accounts, and medical affairs to support product pull through.
  • Performance management: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and analytics to tie team performance to measurable patient outcomes
  • Innovation and continuous improvement: Drive implementation of innovative technology solutions relevant to the market, including potential AI opportunities that will help elevate operational efficiencies and overall effectiveness
  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable healthcare laws, regulations, industry standards, and company policies
  • Budget: Lead budget planning and financial oversight across field reimbursement, patient support programs and all vendors.

Qualification Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in patient services, market access, reimbursement, or other related pharmaceutical/biotech functions
  • Minimum 10+ years in a management or leadership role of people or function
  • Superb knowledge of government and commercial payers for specialty products across buy & bill and specialty pharmacy pathways, prior authorization and appeal requirements, coding, appropriate claim submission, and integration with patient assistance programs
  • Experienced in building strategic patient access and field reimbursement capabilities
  • Proven track record of scaling capabilities for growth
  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, collaboration and communication skills
  • Self-starter attitude.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of time
Salary Range
$315,000—$330,000 USD

raw.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You talk, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation
  • Complete a few clips per recording session

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed
  • Recording environment: A quiet room with no background music, TV, traffic, or other people talking
  • Audio quality: Clear voice, close to the mic, one speaker only, no echo. A headset or earbuds with a mic helps but isn't required
  • Note: Quiet, clean audio matters most - background noise or unclear speech can affect approval

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

  • Solution-selling mentality: develop a plan, articulate value, and navigate customer complexity to drive revenue
  • Cultural awareness and respect for tribal sovereignty, traditions, and community-focused values
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and industry events

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in the software industry or technical sales (e.g., SaaS)
  • Experience with analytics, data, databases, predictive modeling, or business intelligence
  • An existing network in tribal gaming or casino management communities
  • Familiarity with gaming systems (player tracking, casino management platforms) and regulatory frameworks (IGRA, NIGC, state compacts)
