Job Title:

B2B Marketing Strategist

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent. Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

The B2B Marketing Strategist is the SME for B2B and B2B Partner Marketing. The SME will leverage a combination of tech and agency capabilities along with productized solutions within PMG as well as partner with our broader B2B sales practice to design solutions that meet client objectives and KPI commitments.
These solutions will encompass data, technology, marketing and analytics strategies and will be based on a combination of industry best practice and Concentrix proprietary experience.

Concentrix operates an AI-native marketing model that embeds intelligence across the full demand generation lifecycle, from strategy design and campaign architecture through execution and reporting. This role is responsible for translating that model into strategic recommendations for B2B clients and prospects, and is expected to work fluently within Concentrix's AI-native tools and workflows to sharpen strategic thinking and pressure-test recommendations — not just understand them conceptually — without requiring deep technical ownership of the underlying platform.

What you will do in this role

B2B Communications Strategy

  • Contribute to setting a new standard for communications planning, leveraging the extensive capabilities across Concentrix, with a specific focus on partnering with the B2B Sales Practice.
  • Enhance the existing B2B communications planning methodology
  • Educate the broader organization on modern B2B marketing best practices.
  • Understand data, technology and marketing communications requirements among target B2B client prospects
  • Help pre-define communication solutions that support critical B2B and B2B partner engagement stages: demand generation, up-sell/cross-sell and renewals.
  • Work with our digital advertising team to partner with leading data and technology providers to enable best-in-class capabilities.

Consultation & Strategy

  • Proactive sales support internally and with B2B clients for marketing solutions.
  • Partner with sales and solutions teams to develop new prospective marketing solutions and strategies, supporting new business bids and proposals.
  • Maintain a full understanding of Concentrix capabilities and product offerings and can align them to best suit the clients’ needs
  • Understand where, when and how to apply Concentrix capabilities and product offerings to meet client needs and satisfy their objectives
  • Use client and end-customer insights, best practices and past performance as foundation for forming strategic recommendations.
  • Continuous learner by nature. Maintains a broad understanding of B2B buyer trends.
  • Develop and maintains partnership with key technology partners that enable the product offering.

Technology

  • Actively use AI tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot) as part of daily strategic work — research, competitive analysis, client recommendations, proposal development — and role-model this behavior for the broader team.
  • Responsible for understanding the martech and adtech landscape and how technology is used to support effective B2B marketing campaigns that drive business outcomes
  • Are committed to maintaining a current understanding of how all forms of AI (ML, generative, agentic) are impacting marketing communications technology, creative, engagement, etc. and can guide our teams on best integration and use.

Responsibilities

  • Set strategic direction for B2B marketing solutions, translating client objectives into differentiated, defensible program recommendations.
  • Effectively represent Performance Marketing Group products, services and capabilities, along with broader Concentrix capabilities through internal collaboration and client engagement.
  • Collaborate with teams across Concentrix such as development, program management, sales, other solutions colleagues, etc. to develop and maintain capabilities and product offerings leveraging Salesforce technology.
  • Develop communication material that clearly defines the service offering, articulates the value and key differentiators and tailors these communications to the different internal and external audiences.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:

  • Have a Bachelors Degree (BA or BS) in Marketing, Business, Communications, or similar from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • Have 7-9 years of related experience or an equivalent combination of experience and education may be considered.
  • Have experience with designing B2B marketing solutions required.

It will be a plus if you:

  • Have experience working in automotive and technology industries
  • Have experience working with Salesforce and Hubspot

Skills

  • Demonstrated fluency working with AI tools (Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate strategic analysis and client-facing recommendations.
  • Ability to adapt written and verbal communication skills to different styles and environments (persuasive, diplomatic, influential, technical) of clients
  • Able to discern appropriate level of detail of communications including the best method for delivery (video, voice, email, in-person)
  • Advanced problem-solving using an analytics approach; evaluate, investigate and apply best practices and offer innovative solutions
  • Demonstrate the ability to maintain high performance and quality levels in an environment of constant change and pressure
  • Demonstrate the ability to champion significant projects, programs and business initiatives using creativity and ingenuity
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and structure analysis for complex business issues
  • Proven ability to lead and organize multi-disciplinary projects and initiatives in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented business environment with broad impact.
  • Ability to read, write and comprehend complex documents, such as journals, position papers, proposals, contracts, technical/functional specifications, etc.
  • Ability to make effective, persuasive speeches or presentations on complex topics. This includes the ability to sell, negotiate and close deals with customers.
  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills

What's in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:

raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team.This is a Santa Clara, CA or Remote - USA role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Zscaler Client Connector team. You will be working on the Client Connector, which protects corporate devices by securely and privately sending traffic from those devices to Zscaler’s global network, which can apply advanced web filtering and advanced Zero Trust policies. In your role, you will predominantly be using Rust along with platform-native languages & APIs to implement high-performance networking code that runs on multiple desktop platforms. You’ll be expected to improve the code quality and to build solid, testable, and well-documented foundations. You will be most successful in this role if you have a good understanding of System Programming (virtual memory, multi-threading, process lifecycle, kernel programming, system APIs, etc.) and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, QUIC, H/3, proxying, etc.). You will also have to interact with other languages, such as Swift, C++, and Python. As a Staff Engineer, you will be expected to make significant contributions to the design and implementation of major development projects, working closely with our product managers and other teams to implement customer-impacting features. You will work on stimulating problems born out of the scale of our deployment, and the stringent quality, performance, and security requirements of our product.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and implement high-performance, low-complexity networking code for the Zscaler Client Connector predominantly using Rust
  • Build solid, easily-testable, and well-documented foundations to improve code quality across multiple desktop platforms
  • Debug complex network-related problems and implement solutions using systems programming and security protocols
  • Contribute significantly to the design of major development projects and collaborate closely with product managers and cross-functional teams
  • Communicate proactively and constructively to solve stimulating scale, quality, performance, and security problems

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Thrive in ambiguity by comfortably building paths forward in a dynamic environment, viewing uncertainty as an opportunity to create meaningful impact.
  • Act like an owner with a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Foster high-trust collaboration, welcoming candor, respect, and constructive feedback to drive collective success for the entire team.
  • Bring a positive force to the team, approaching complex challenges with constructive energy and a contagious 'can-do' spirit.
  • Build pragmatically by balancing a drive for technical excellence with a passion for iteratively creating, testing, and shipping high-value solutions.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience with hands-on software development, in languages like C++
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience coding with Rust, particularly in systems programming and async frameworks like Tokio and Reqwest
  • Deep experience with networking, particularly tunneling applications and IPv4/IPv6 transport mechanisms

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Experience using AI coding tools throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Cross-platform development experience across multiple client operating systems, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android
  • Experience with software development in Swift and Objective-C

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

Base Pay Range
$152,000—$190,000 USD

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!

raw.description:
Make an Impact Through Healthcare Technology at St. Jude!
Join our Clinical Applications team and help optimize the technology that supports exceptional patient care.

As a Clinical Applications Analyst I, you will partner with clinicians, operational leaders, and Information Services teams to support and enhance Epic inpatient applications while developing expertise in healthcare technology and clinical workflows.

This role is ideal for a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys working with technology, improving processes, and helping end users achieve better outcomes.
We'd love to have someone with a strong customer mindset and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills would be very helpful in this role. Finally, being able to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders is important.

Why Join Us?

- Work directly with clinical leaders and care teams to improve healthcare delivery.
- Gain hands-on experience with Epic and healthcare technology solutions.
- Participate in meaningful projects that improve workflows and support patient care.
- Access professional development opportunities, including Epic certification and ongoing learning.
- Join a collaborative team dedicated to innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Applications Supported:
+ Epic Clinical Documentation (ClinDoc)
+ Orders
+ Bugsy
+ Grand Central
+ OpTime
+ Anesthesia


This position may be eligible for remote work. However, St. Jude requires all remote employees to:
-Travel to our Memphis campus for the interview process and/or orientation, if selected
-Travel to Memphis to work on-site for one week per quarter, or as requested based on business needs, if hired.
By applying, you acknowledge and agree to these travel requirements as a condition of employment.
This position is remote within approved U.S. locations. Due to state-specific employment regulations, we are unable to consider applicants currently residing in California for remote work; however, candidates based in California who are willing to relocate to an approved location may be considered.

Responsibilities:


  • Participate in meetings with business teams to elicit and understand business/process requirements
  • Conduct analyses to report emerging business needs; escalate problems when required.
  • Support resolution of needs and requests of business teams within area, in coordination with other IT teams.
  • Independently conduct activities related to assigned area (including documentation, communication with business teams) around enterprise IT platforms/services.
  • Assist in optimization of standardized/pre-described business requirement gathering support processes in assigned area.
  • Periodically present results to team in project meetings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to meet the goals and objectives of the department and institution.
  • Maintains regular and predictable attendance.

Key Preferred Responsibilities:


  • Serve as a subject matter resource for assigned Epic inpatient applications.
  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to understand workflow and business requirements.
  • Analyze processes and identify opportunities for workflow improvement and system optimization.
  • Support application maintenance, upgrades, enhancements, and issue resolution.
  • Gather, document, and validate business and technical requirements.
  • Participate in testing activities, including test planning, execution, defect tracking, and validation.
  • Maintain accurate project, workflow, and technical documentation.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and standardization efforts.
  • Complete Epic training and certification requirements as assigned.

Minimum Education and/or Training:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, business or related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field preferred.
  • It would be helpful to have an EPIC certification, but not required.

Minimum Experience:


  • Some experience and/or understanding of structured Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
  • Some experience and/or understanding of identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, application support, business process design and/or technical documentation preferred.
  • Foundational knowledge of application support and/or business analysis in a clinical environment is preferred.

Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by Law:

  • None

Licensure, Registration and/or Certification Required by SJCRH Only:

  • None

Special Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:


  • Ability to think critically, draw insights and connect the dots. Openness to change and adapting to changing times with resilience and flexibility.
  • Learns on the job and applies skills in routine tasks and activities; delivers under supervision and guidance
  • Understands the task at hand, seeks out information, and draws conclusions from available data to deliver outcomes. Adapts quickly to changing priorities to perform as needed in his/her role. Remains calm when faced with changes to (and in) his/her work.
  • Skills in communicating complex ideas effectively to diverse audiences and influence others to see different points of view.
  • Seeks clarifications to understand what is being said. Is able to clearly summarize information learnt to confirm understanding. Writes in a clear and concise manner and speaks succinctly and confidently.
  • Focus on setting high targets, following through with actions, and achieving results. Ability to anticipate roadblocks and circumvent challenges.
  • Plans in advance, organizes own work, and executes high-quality work on time. Shows initiative to take on more responsibilities/work. Embraces goals and demonstrates a sense of urgency in achieving them. Holds self to high standards and keeps pushing to meet them.
  • Business analysis skills and ability to elicit and understand business/process/system requirements and translating into tech. needs.
  • Shows basic awareness of business analysis tools, requirement definition templates, tools, and processes. Is able to support requirement gathering and documentation. Provides operational/ coordination support for business, system, and process analysis.
  • Skills in prioritizing and addressing needs from multiple customers/stakeholders with a focus on efficient, responsive, high-quality/fit-for-purpose delivery.
  • Seeks to understand customer needs by asking clarifying questions. Prioritizes responses to customer queries. Solves routine customer problems as per processes, and seeks guidance, if needed for quick resolution.
  • Ability to take accountability for work outcomes and proactively account for interdependencies across adjacent work areas.
  • Organizes own work tasks, provides periodic updates and executes on time. Delivers work which is of quality with attention to detail. Learns from mistakes and quickly makes changes. Shows initiative and drive. Speaks clearly and asks clarifying questions as needed.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:


  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; kneel, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and talk or hear.

  • Nothing in this job description limits management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time as business needs dictate. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not proscribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. The information contained herein is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor is it intended to be an all-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job.

Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $65,520 - $114,400 per year for the role of Clinical Applications Analyst I (EPIC Inpatient Applications).

Job Title: Business Development Manager — Diagnostics Kitting
Reports To: Director, Global Commerce
Direct Reports: No

Job Summary: Tennant Solutions is expanding beyond its core clinical efficacy kitting business into the broader diagnostics market — at-home test manufacturers, reference labs, and clinical trial sponsors. This is a new hunter role: the first sales hire dedicated to this expansion, with a mandate to build pipeline and close new logos business from a standing start.

There is no existing book of business in this vertical. Success depends on prospecting, relationship-building, and consultative selling into diagnostics companies with no prior awareness of Tennant Solutions' kitting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Prospect and open new accounts across diagnostics manufacturers, reference labs, and clinical trial sponsors with no existing relationship with Tennant Solutions.
  • Build and manage a full-cycle sales pipeline — cold outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Translate technical kitting capabilities (component sourcing, cleanroom assembly, sterile packaging, lot traceability) into a value proposition specific to diagnostics buyers: regulatory pressure, IVDR/FDA compliance, supply chain reliability, and scale-up speed.
  • Partner with operations and quality teams to scope custom kitting proposals, validate feasibility, and price new business.
  • Represent Tennant Solutions at industry conferences, trade shows, and diagnostics-sector events to build visibility in a market where the company has no existing brand presence.
  • Report pipeline, forecast, and win/loss data to leadership on a [weekly/monthly] cadence to inform go-to-market strategy for the vertical.
  • Feed market intelligence back to leadership on diagnostics-sector needs, competitive positioning, and pricing to shape the long-term strategy for this expansion.


Qualifications:
Required:
  • 3+ years of medical device industry sales experience, with demonstrated success in a hunter or new-business-development capacity — not primarily account management.
  • Proven ability to prospect and close new logosbusinesses without inherited pipeline or existing relationships.
  • Comfort selling technical, custom-engineered solutions rather than off-the-shelf products.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for client visits, trade shows, and conferences.
Preferred:
  • Direct experience selling kitting, contract manufacturing, or contract packaging services into medical device or diagnostics OEMs.
  • Existing relationships or familiarity with diagnostics-sector buyers: at-home test manufacturers, reference labs, or clinical trial sponsors/CROs.
  • Working knowledge of IVD regulatory context (FDA, IVDR) sufficient to speak credibly with technical and quality stakeholders.
  • Experience selling into procurement and quality/regulatory stakeholders simultaneously — multi-threaded, longer-cycle B2B sales.

  • Location: Remote or Hybrid

  • Travel Required: up to 50%

raw.description:
Job Title: Senior Archaeologist
Job Location: Remote
Job Code: SA-2026
Job Link:Senior Archaeologist - Southeastern Archaeological Research, LLC. "SEARCH"

SEARCH is seeking a Senior Archaeologist to support various projects in the US. The position can be remote or based out of one of our offices is Orlando, Jacksonville, Pensacola, or New Orleans.

Successful candidates will have a background in cultural resource management. The candidate should have excellent technical writing skills and the ability to produce reports for review by subject matter experts on behalf of federal, state, and tribal agencies under Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act and the National Environmental Policy Act, among other historic preservation laws/regulations.

  • Use experience, education from a degreed program, and professional judgment to identify and target locations of enhanced site probability based on cultural, geological, and other environmental features
  • Administer the project health and safety plan, participate in office and field training, and offer recommendations for improvement to health and safety manager
  • ·Have a thorough understanding of the research design and ensure its implementation
  • Based upon education, field observations, and scientific judgement, revise field methodology to meet overall project goals, in consultation with project leadership
  • Perform pre-field background research, prepare maps, input data into electronic devices, and prepare project summary for field staff
  • Provide leadership to field teams conducting archaeological monitoring, survey, testing, and excavation in support of Phase I, II, and III studies in accordance with the research design to identify, record, and evaluate archaeological resources
  • Recognize archaeological signatures and apply reasoning to evaluate the extent and integrity of resources
  • Record accurate, organized, and clear field notes, maps, drawings, logs, forms, tables, databases, artifact bags, box labels, and other project documentation
  • Collect and inventory artifacts, ecofacts, and samples in accordance with the research design, and keep an accurate field specimen log
  • Identify potential human and faunal remains, and treat any suspected human remains respectfully and in a manner consistent with the research design and applicable state and federal guidelines and laws
  • Perform quality control of field data (hand-written and electronic) daily to ensure information is accurate and complete
  • Use electronic and traditional navigational equipment (GPS, Field Maps, compass and transit) to determine project limits, record fieldwork, document findings, and communicate progress
  • Photo-document artifacts, features, excavation units, land use, landscapes, unique environmental features, historic structures, archaeological sites, unique environmental features, specialized equipment or technique usage, and work-in-progress (keep an accurate photo log)
  • Use or review GIS data to organize, interpret, and document field research
  • Under supervision of the principal investigator, identify, record, and prepare preliminary evaluations of archaeological resources in accordance with state and federal laws, particularly the National Register of Historical Places (NRHP)
  • Provide daily updates on project progress to the principal investigator or project manager
  • Meet with, coordinate, and collaborate with landowners, land agents, clients, other field research teams, and visiting regulatory agency staff
  • Interview informants to gather information on history and use of property
  • Prepare thorough, accurate, professional, high-quality technical reports, including writing tasks, graphics, report production, and quality control
  • Assist the principal investigator or project manager with other research, project management, and administrative tasks
  • Prepare research permit applications for review and submittal by the principal investigator
  • Under the supervision of a principal investigator or project manager, draft proposals and cost estimates
  • Procure and maintain field equipment, technology, vehicles, and supplies in a clean, working, and safe manner and report any malfunctions, shortages, and risks to principal investigator or project manager
  • Complete timesheets and other administrative or project requirements accurately and on schedule
  • Understand and adhere to the SEARCH Brand Guidelines, SEARCH Style Guide, SEARCH Fieldwork Guide, and the SEARCH Employee Manual, and encourage others to do the same

Application Requirements

  • Cover letter
  • CV/resume
  • Minimum of three professional references
  • Three writing samples (if a collaborative report, identify sections authored). Writing samples should be sent to . Include the Job Posting code (SA-2026) in the subject line of your email.

Other Important Need-to-Know Information

  • Applicants must be eligible to be employed in the United States.
  • Applicants must have a valid Driver’s License and reliable transportation.
  • SEARCH offers a competitive total compensation package with strong health and wellness and retirement plans.
  • Pay is commensurate with education and experience.
  • SEARCH is strongly committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where a variety of backgrounds, cultures, orientations, ideas, and talents can flourish.
  • SEARCH is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  • SEARCH is an Affirmative Action Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
  • Employment offers are contingent upon satisfactory verification of criminal, education, driving, and/or employment background checks, as well as passing results from a pre‑employment drug screen.

About Us:

SEARCH is a global leader in archaeology, maritime archaeology, and the full spectrum of cultural heritage services. Our staff are industry leaders and subject matter experts who support commercial and government clients worldwide. Since 1993, we have completed over 5,700 projects nationwide and in over 40 countries across seven continents and four oceans. By integrating science, technology, and creativity, we harness the power of the past to advance the projects, places, and people we serve.

Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in anthropology, archaeology, or a closely related field
    • Completion of an accredited archaeological field school, six months of field experience, or both
    • Minimum five years of professional archaeological field experience encompassing some supervisory experience
    • Valid driver's license. good driving record, access to reliable transportation
    • Ability to obtain government security clearance

Benefits

SEARCH Compensation and Benefits include:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Per Diem (for overnight travel)
  • SEARCH-subsidized Group Health Insurance (including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage)
  • SEARCH-provided Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • SEARCH-provided Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • SEARCH-provided Group Term Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Emergency Travel Assistance
  • Generous 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Paid Holidays (11)
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Merit-Based Raises, Bonuses, and Promotions

raw.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern, cloud-based data platforms that power analytics, AI, and data products across the organization. Beyond technical delivery, we're looking for someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data — someone who can apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

You will work on scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines, enabling high-quality, curated datasets while ensuring robust data governance, security, and observability across the data ecosystem. You will also play a key role in supporting AI and GenAI systems, enabling pipelines for machine learning, causal modeling, and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

This role can be delivered on either of our two core cloud ecosystems — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — and you'll be staffed on projects that match your strongest platform. You don't need experience in both. Additional experience across Snowflake or GCP is considered a strong plus.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and platform teams to ensure the data foundation supports production-grade, decision-oriented AI systems.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on whichever of our two core ecosystems matches your strengths — AWS (with Databricks) or Azure/Fabric (with Databricks or native Fabric tooling) — with exposure to other environments (Snowflake, GCP) considered a plus. This includes developing reliable batch, streaming, and near-real-time pipelines using technologies such as Spark and Delta Lake, and building ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for both structured and unstructured data.

You will implement modern data architectures including lakehouse patterns and medallion layering (bronze, silver, gold) within Databricks or Fabric, ensuring systems are reusable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise needs.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

Deliver high-quality datasets that support analytics, machine learning, causal modeling, and optimization systems. You will enable data pipelines for GenAI use cases (including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and vector-based data flows), as well as agent-based architectures and intelligent workflows, ensuring that data is model-ready and production-grade — leveraging Databricks' MLflow and Unity Catalog, or the equivalent Azure/Fabric and Azure ML tooling, depending on the platform you work in.

Data Modeling, Orchestration & Automation

Design scalable logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring consistency across domains. Orchestrate workflows using tools such as Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or equivalents, with strong focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability of end-to-end pipelines.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

Apply modern architecture patterns including event-driven and streaming architectures, and ensure adherence to best practices in data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC), using tools such as Unity Catalog and AWS Lake Formation, or Microsoft Purview, depending on the platform in use.

Establish strong data observability, including monitoring of data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence, ensuring systems remain trustworthy and production-ready.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

Enable data serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) to support downstream systems, including ML and AI platforms. Continuously monitor and optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across our core cloud ecosystems.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

Bring genuine curiosity to every engagement — ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders are asking for, but why. Apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and refine business requirements, surfacing gaps or better alternatives where they exist rather than simply executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data solutions. Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices across the data and AI ecosystem.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Delta Lake, and strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Proven experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and production-grade data platforms, with solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance principles.

Cloud & Platforms (Key Requirement) — choose your track:

  • Track A: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with AWS data services (e.g., S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda) and the Databricks Lakehouse Platform
  • Track B: Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure / Fabric (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse, Azure Databricks)

You only need deep expertise in one track — we treat both as equally weighted core platforms and will align you to projects based on where your experience is strongest. Familiarity with other modern data platforms such as Snowflake or GCP is a plus but not required.

Architecture & Systems Thinking

Experience with lakehouse architectures and distributed data systems, and strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance considerations in data pipelines.

Mindset

Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills focused on scalability and reliability, and a collaborative approach to working in cross-functional teams. Comfortable applying common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and challenge business requirements rather than taking them at face value. Experience in Agile or consulting environments is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

Deep expertise in both tracks — AWS and Azure/Fabric, across Databricks and native Fabric tooling — is a strong plus, though not required, as is experience with GenAI and AI data systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation), CI/CD for data pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Additional exposure to streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), Spark optimization, or advanced analytics and ML workloads (including causal or experimentation platforms) is valuable. Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms is also beneficial.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a position based in Poland.

Mental and physical health:

  • 24 working days of paid vacation
  • National holidays covered
  • Sick leave (up to 20/year)
  • Unpaid leave (up to 20/year)
  • Medical insurance
  • Multisport card OR Multikafeteria
  • Maternity & paternity leave support

Personal and professional development:

  • Internal workshops & learning initiatives

raw.excerpt: OverviewDane Street is seeking experienced Board-Certified Toxicologists to join our growing team of expert clinical reviewers.
raw.description:
Overview

Dane Street is seeking experienced Board-Certified Toxicologists to join our growing team of expert clinical reviewers. In this role, you will apply your specialized toxicology expertise to conduct comprehensive reviews of clinical cases and provide objective, evidence-based medical advisory opinions.

This is a fully remote opportunity that allows you to customize your schedule while working as a 1099 independent contractor. The position is intended for physicians residing in Texas with appropriate Texas medical licensure.

Your primary responsibilities will include reviewing medical records, laboratory results, medication and substance exposure histories, toxicology reports, and relevant clinical documentation; preparing clear and concise clinical summaries; and responding to specific questions from clients related to toxicologic findings, diagnoses, treatment, causation, and medical care.

This role involves advisory medical record reviews only and does not involve peer-to-peer discussions, calls, or direct patient care.

Areas of Expertise

We are currently seeking professionals with expertise in:

  • Medical toxicology
  • Clinical toxicology and toxicologic evaluation
  • Medication and substance exposures, including adverse drug events and poisonings
  • Overdose and intoxication assessment
  • Toxicology laboratory testing and interpretation
  • Evaluation of poisoning, adverse drug reactions, and toxic exposures
  • Emergency and acute-care toxicology
  • Substance-related medical conditions
  • Review of toxicology reports, laboratory results, medication records, and clinical documentation
  • Assessment of the medical necessity and appropriateness of toxicology-related evaluation and treatment
  • Evidence-based assessment of toxicologic diagnoses, treatment, and outcomes
  • Review of causation and clinical relationships related to toxic exposures, when applicable

Join a team that values your clinical judgment and commitment to improving the quality, accuracy, and consistency of healthcare assessments. Your expertise plays a vital role in supporting high-quality, objective, and defensible medical determinations.

Requirements

  • MD or DO from an accredited medical school
  • Board Certification in Medical Toxicology or appropriate board certification with significant experience and expertise in toxicology
  • Current, unrestricted Texas medical license
  • Minimum of 5+ years of clinical experience in toxicology or a related clinical specialty
  • Ability to attend all required orientation and training sessions
  • Maintains appropriate credentialing, state licensure, board certification, and any other certifications required to perform the role
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to communicate findings clearly and objectively in written form
  • Expertise in reviewing medical records, laboratory results, toxicology reports, medication records, and clinical documentation
  • Ability to provide concise, well-supported, evidence-based clinical opinions
  • Strong understanding of current clinical guidelines and evidence relevant to toxicologic conditions and treatment

Benefits

  • Independent consultant role offering schedule flexibility and predictable work hours
  • Ability to choose case types and workload based on your availability
  • No peer-to-peer calls or discussions
  • No physician–patient relationship established; no treatment is provided — all reviews are advisory only
  • Streamlined case flow through a user-friendly online work portal
  • Dane Street manages administrative processes, medical record organization, and communications
  • Fully prepared cases with organized medical records, laboratory and toxicology documentation, and applicable clinical guidelines
  • Initial training provided, along with ongoing support and a dedicated point of contact
  • Fully remote work from Texas

Location

Texas, United States

This is a fully remote 1099 independent contractor opportunity for physicians who maintain an active, unrestricted Texas medical license.

Position Summary
The AWS Cloud Engineer – IL6 / Backend & Database is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, securing, and maintaining cloud-based solutions within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Impact Level 6 (IL6) environments supporting mission-critical government and Department of Defense (DoD) programs.

The position combines advanced AWS cloud engineering, backend application development, and database engineering responsibilities. The engineer will develop and integrate backend services, APIs, data services, and database solutions while ensuring that infrastructure and applications meet stringent security, performance, scalability, availability, and compliance requirements.

This position is 100% remote.

Salary Range: 130k+

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, deploy, configure, and maintain secure AWS infrastructure within IL6 environments.
  • Develop, integrate, and maintain backend applications, microservices, APIs, and data services supporting mission-critical systems.
  • Design and implement scalable, highly available database architectures within AWS.
  • Develop and optimize relational databases, including schema design, indexing, queries, stored procedures, transactions, and performance tuning.
  • Work with technologies such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and other AWS database services as appropriate.
  • Design and implement data models and database schemas that support application and mission requirements.
  • Develop cloud-native applications using serverless, containerized, and microservices architectures where appropriate.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated application, infrastructure, and database deployments.
  • Implement and maintain AWS security controls consistent with DoD, DISA, FedRAMP, NIST, and RMF requirements.
  • Configure and manage AWS IAM, encryption, secrets management, security groups, logging, monitoring, and other security capabilities.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and administering AWS cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working in AWS IL6, AWS GovCloud, or comparable high-security government cloud environments.
  • Experience with one or more enterprise database platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or Amazon Aurora.
  • Experience with AWS database services such as RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing database schemas, data models, relationships, and data-access layers.
  • Experience developing REST APIs, microservices, or other backend services.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience implementing security controls within regulated AWS environments.
  • Understanding of NIST 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud and IL6 environments.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora PostgreSQL in large-scale production environments.
  • Experience with DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with database replication, clustering, partitioning, and high-availability architectures.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Implementation Manager

Location: Remote

Reports To: VP of Operations, BEC Legal Systems

Travel: Estimated 5-10%: periodic visits to the Cincinnati office, occasional client sites, and industry conferences (e.g., ILTACON)

About BEC Legal Systems

BEC Legal Systems has served the legal community for decades, evolving from its roots in Cincinnati, Ohio into a trusted provider of enterprise software for law firms and corporate legal departments nationwide. Our BEC CoreRelate Framework - including MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, and Assemble-It - helps legal teams manage attorney calendars, track matters, and automate document creation directly within the Microsoft Office environment they already rely on.

Our clients stay with us because our team knows their firms, their workflows, and their deadlines. As we modernize our support organization - new tooling, a real knowledge base, and AI woven into how the work gets done - we are hiring a leader to own that function and make responsiveness a competitive advantage.

About the Role

As Implementation Manager, you will own the day-to-day management and implementation of BEC Legal Systems suite of products and upgrades from kickoff through go-live. You will consult directly with clients to understand their unique business needs, design and configure solutions that meet those needs, and deliver the training that enables our client base to fully adopt our software.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role that combines project management, software configuration, and training delivery. You will work closely with internal teams – R&D, QA, Support, and Sales – to ensure every implementation is delivered in line with customer expectations, and you will travel to client sites and other locations as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Establish close working relationships with all internal teams to ensure all aspects of each project are well managed and delivered in line with customer expectations.
  • Business Practice Consultation: Work with clients to understand and explore their current business practices, helping to identify and form best practices that can be implemented during the software installation or conversion.
  • Implementation Delivery: Deliver responsive implementations of BEC's products in a timely manner, from initial configuration through go-live.
  • Client Education: Educate clients on proper software configuration, application integrations, and data entry so they can fully leverage the software's capabilities.
  • Training Delivery: Conduct onsite and web-based training sessions for client teams.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Assist clients during implementation and post-go-live, including reporting of issues and enhancement requests.
  • Product Expertise: Provide product use expertise to internal R&D and QA teams, informing product direction and quality.
  • Internal Training: Assist with training of the Company's employees when needed.
  • Helpdesk Support: Provide Helpdesk support when needed.

Core Competencies

  • Legal workflow fluency: Bring a working understanding of how our clients use BEC and use it to interpret requests, process severity, and represent the client’s reality. Deeply understands the needs of a docketing team, paralegal or legal assistant, and can earn the trust of our user base by speaking to their reality.
  • Presentation and Communication Skills: Communicates clearly and confidently in front of clients, whether delivering training or walking through a proposed solution. Writes and speaks clearly and professionally to sophisticated legal-industry clients, particularly in challenging situations.
  • Process Management: Manages the many moving pieces of an implementation – configuration, training, data, and timelines – to a successful, on-schedule go-live.
  • Problem Solving: Diagnoses client needs and implementation issues methodically, and finds workable solutions under real-world constraints.
  • Innovation Management: Brings creativity to configuring the software to fit each client's unique workflows, rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Customer Focus: Keeps the client's needs and experience at the center of every implementation decision.
  • Learning on the Fly: Picks up new product functionality, client environments, and edge cases quickly, and adapts on the spot.
  • Standing Alone: Works independently and confidently at client sites and in situations without immediate support.
  • Patience: Remains calm and supportive while guiding clients – including less technical users – through new software and changing processes.
  • AI Fluency and Judgment: Uses generative AI tools to improve speed and quality of support work, and applies the judgment to know where AI output needs verification before a client sees it.
  • Adaptability and Resourcefulness: Operates effectively in a lean, close-knit organization, balancing daily delivery with building in a resource-constrained environment.

Success Metrics: First 6 & 12 Months

First 6 Months

  • Complete onboarding into BEC's product suite (MatterLink, Docket Enterprise, LegalBar, Assemble-It, CoreRelate Cloud, and CoreRespond) and shadow or co-lead implementations across the core products.
  • Independently own the day-to-day management of new implementations and upgrades, from initial client consultation through configuration and go-live.
  • Deliver onsite and web-based training sessions directly to clients with confidence and positive client feedback.
  • Build working relationships with R&D, QA, and other internal teams, establishing a clear hand-off process for issues and enhancement requests.
  • Demonstrate solid command of client business practices well enough to recommend best practices during installations and conversions.

First 12 Months

  • Consistently deliver responsive, on-time implementations across an established client caseload.
  • Serve as a go-to product expert for internal R&D and QA teams, with input reflected in product improvements.
  • Contribute to internal training of Company employees, extending product and implementation expertise beyond the immediate team.
  • Build a track record of strong post-go-live client outcomes, reflected in client feedback and reduced escalations.
  • Take on Helpdesk support coverage as needed, without disruption to implementation workload.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree, or an equivalent combination of experience and education.
  • 5+ years in a customer-facing professional services role leading client onboarding and implementations.
  • Hands-on experience with legal practice management, matter management, or document automation platforms (e.g., BEC's suite — Docket Enterprise, MatterLink, LegalBar, Assemble-It, CoreRelate Cloud — or comparable tools) as a user or administrator.
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve personal productivity, optimize workflows, or improve client communication.
  • Capability to excel in a data-driven, metrics-oriented environment, and to build the metrics where they do not yet exist.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong listening skills and a genuine service orientation.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely, in a lean organization where leaders are both strategic and hands-on.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Outlook, Word, SharePoint) and with document management systems such as NetDocuments or iManage.
  • Exposure to cloud operations or hosted application support environments.

raw.description:
The Clinical Compliance Auditor II is responsible for ensuring Guidehealth’s clinical operations, utilization management activities, and delegated services comply with regulatory requirements, client contractual obligations, and internal clinical standards. This role serves as a senior clinical compliance subject matter expert and performs advanced auditing, monitoring, and compliance validation activities to ensure adherence to Utilization Management (UM) and Population Health Management (PHM) Plans, Managed Services Agreements (MSAs), and value-based care program requirements.

In addition to conducting audits, this role provides leadership through mentorship, process improvement, audit program development, and cross-functional collaboration. The Clinical Compliance Auditor II partners closely with Clinical Leadership, Compliance, and Operations teams to identify risks, support regulatory readiness, and ensure clinical services meet the highest standards of accuracy, quality, and compliance.
This position operates with a high degree of autonomy, exercising independent judgment to evaluate compliance risks, support operational improvements, and strengthen Guidehealth’s clinical compliance infrastructure.

As a growing and innovative organization, we operate with a high degree of agility. Employees are expected to adapt to evolving business needs, step in to support cross-functional initiatives, and contribute beyond traditional role boundaries when needed. This collaborative and flexible mindset is essential to our success. We encourage cross-training, ongoing development, and a commitment to learning across all areas of the business—ensuring we continue to grow as a high-performing, mission-driven team and you continue to grow and thrive as a member of our high-performing, mission-mission driven team.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting comprehensive clinical compliance audits, including utilization management, denial documentation, clinical reporting, authorization compliance, and delegated services requirements.
  • Monitoring adherence to UM and PHM Plans, Managed Services Agreements, and client-specific contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Performing routine, scheduled, and ad hoc audits to assess compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards, and client obligations.
  • Serving as a secondary reviewer for denial documentation to ensure regulatory and contractual compliance.
  • Monitoring audit findings to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational and compliance improvement.
  • Monitoring clinical workflows and reporting processes to detect compliance risks, documentation deficiencies, or process gaps.
  • Assisting in developing and maintaining audit tools, audit protocols, and compliance monitoring frameworks.
  • Assisting in the development and maintenance of the UM and PHM Plans and clinical compliance procedures.
  • Providing mentorship, guidance, and subject matter expertise to Clinical Compliance Auditors and clinical operations staff.
  • Supporting leadership in identifying training needs and opportunities for clinical compliance improvement.
  • Assisting in facilitating audit reviews, reporting processes, and compliance committee support activities.
  • Analyzing audit results and clinical data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for operational and compliance improvement.
  • Preparing and presenting audit findings and compliance reports to clinical leadership and operational stakeholders.
  • Supporting the development of reporting tools, dashboards, and audit metrics to monitor compliance performance.

What you'll need for success

  • Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required.
  • Strong knowledge of utilization management processes, clinical documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in utilization management, clinical auditing, clinical compliance, or managed care.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Commercial Managed Care, and delegated services compliance requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound professional judgment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and reporting tools.

What we'd love for you to have

  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical compliance auditing or healthcare auditing experience.

The salary for this role is $82,000.00 to $87,000.00 per year based upon experience and skills.

raw.description:
About CADIS GmbH

CADIS GmbH is an established German software company and the team behind cadis® TMS, a platform built to digitally manage and control complex logistics processes. Our software empowers logistics and transport companies to take control of their operations, reducing complexity, cutting costs, and delivering measurable results for their customers.

With a growing client base across the DACH region and a product with a proven track record, we’re well-positioned for the next phase of growth. That’s where you come in.

Your Role

As a Product Manager, you are responsible for overseeing the development and lifecycle of one or more of our products. You will collaborate with engineering, marketing, design, sales, and other departments to define product vision, strategy, and roadmap – ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that meet market needs and align with our business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
  • Conduct market research and customer interviews to identify product opportunities.
  • Analyze market trends, customer feedback, and competitive landscape to drive product decisions.
  • Develop AI-focused product strategies, including AI go-to-market approaches and pricing models for new products.

Product Development

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and other teams to define product requirements and specifications.
  • Prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on business goals, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring the team is focused on delivering the highest value items.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering to ensure product requirements are understood and implemented.
  • Coordinate with sales, marketing, and customer support to ensure successful product launches and customer adoption.
  • Ensure clear communication of product goals, status, and timelines across teams.

Market & Customer Insights

  • Lead product discovery efforts, including customer research, competitor analysis, and usability testing.
  • Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback and iterate on product features.
  • Track product performance and KPIs, adjusting strategy as needed based on insights and results.
  • Organize and lead regular customer advisory board sessions to gather strategic input, validate product direction, and strengthen key customer relationships.

Product Launch & Lifecycle Management

  • Lead the go-to-market strategy for new products and features, ensuring all teams are aligned for successful launches.
  • Define and execute AI-specific go-to-market strategies, including pricing model development for AI-powered products.
  • Monitor and optimize the product throughout its lifecycle, from concept to retirement.
  • Provide ongoing support for the product and address any issues that arise post-launch.

What You Bring

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – able to think strategically and execute tactically.
  • Experience using product management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Aha!, Productboard).
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken) is required.
  • Willingness to travel – you’re comfortable visiting customers and being on-site when needed. (20%-30%)

What We Offer

  • Clear career path: a defined development trajectory with room to grow.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership: short decision-making cycles and flat hierarchies mean your ideas are heard and acted on.
  • Modern tech stack: cutting-edge AI tools built into our day-to-day workflows.
  • Flexible working: remote-first with hybrid options, designed around your life – not just your work hours.
  • Competitive compensation: attractive base salary with performance-based incentives.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

  • Get paid to talk - no perfect grammar, no formality: earn up to $30/hour depending on your pace and approval rate
  • Do it from your couch, your phone, wherever's comfortable
  • Flexible, from home, paid per approved recording
  • If you naturally mix Chinese and English when you speak, you're exactly who we're looking for

367 Agency is a performance-driven creative and digital marketing agency headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.

367 Agency is a lean, results-oriented D2C performance marketing agency with a strong track record in ecommerce-driven growth. Armed with experienced leadership, a wide breadth of service offerings, and a culture built around autonomy and reliability, company has helped many brands punch well above their weight across digital channels.

Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Partner Billing Specialist oversees the execution and stewardship of partner-related billings. Acting as the critical bridge between external partners, the Motive Billing and Finance teams, and Motive Partnerships teams, this role ensures accurate, compliant, and timely payments and invoicing across various partner programs, including Insurance, Strategic, Franchise, and Networks.

In this role, you will be a key individual contributor responsible for managing accurate and timely coordination with our partners. You will play a pivotal part in maintaining the financial health of our partnerships by forecasting, managing Purchase Order (PO) requisitions, and overseeing end-to-end approval processes to ensure seamless execution.

What You'll Do:

Billing & Invoicing Execution

  • End-to-End Invoicing: Ensure accurate and timely payments to, and invoices from, diverse Partner programs (Insurance, Strategic, Franchises, and Networks).
  • PO Management & Forecasting: Manage and forecast Purchase Order (PO) requisitions, driving the approval processes to ensure compliance and prevent payment delays.
  • Partner Coordination: Act as the primary financial liaison, taking responsibility for accurate and timely coordination with external partners to resolve billing inquiries and ensure alignment.

Data Stewardship

  • System Integrity & Querying: Write and execute SQL queries on Snowflake to properly maintain and steward Partnerships-related charges originating from Finance, Product, and Quote to Cash tables in Google Sheets.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with the Partnerships Operations Manager to maintain the accuracy of this data and ensure reliable reporting.

Payout Logic & Tracking

  • Partner Onboarding: Collaborate with the Partnerships Operations Manager to financially onboard new partners into the Motive ecosystem across key tools.
  • Financial Frameworks: Define payout logic and maintain active trackers to ensure transparent and accurate revenue shares and payouts.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience: 4-6 years of professional experience in Operations, Business Administration, Partnerships, or a related analytical field. Experience in Billing, Finance Operations, Partner Operations, or Accounts Payable/Receivable is highly preferred, but not required if you possess strong operational and analytical fundamentals.
  • Intellectual Curiosity / Tinkerer: This role should be willing to learn new skills and tools to drive continuous improvement. Experience in, or a strong willingness to learn, SQL and new AI tools is required. You will need to write and execute basic queries to manage datasets across different business systems. (Note: SQL training can be provided if needed).
  • Own Outcomes: You have a strong sense of accountability for both individual and team goals. You clearly communicate, consistently deliver your best work, take responsibility when you fall short, and proactively speak up when you need help.
  • Process Ownership: You are highly organized, self-sufficient, and comfortable managing complex PO requisitions, forecasting, and cross-departmental approval workflows with minimal hand-holding.
  • Solid Judgement: You are highly autonomous and capable of making sound decisions independently. You know how to effectively navigate ambiguity, leveraging existing policies and precedents to guide your actions, while recognizing exactly when to proactively seek guidance or escalate complex issues.
  • Partnership Fluency: Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. You understand how to translate operational or financial requirements into clear action items for external partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong capability in data stewardship, tracking complex logic, and utilizing tools (like Google Sheets/Excel) to maintain accuracy across various business processes.

Why Join Us?

  • Impact: You will be a foundational pillar for our partner ecosystem, ensuring the financial operations that drive our indirect revenue streams run flawlessly.
  • Market Opportunity: Businesses operating physical operations and commercial fleets are undergoing a massive digital transformation, and Motive provides the essential AI-driven platform they need. You will support the partners helping us distribute this critical technology.
  • Culture: We value builders and owners. You will have the autonomy to drive operational excellence within our partnerships billing processes.
