raw.description:
*This position is contingent on contract award*
Who is DeepSeas
With 30 years of experience in cyber defense, DeepSeas is trusted by nearly 1,000 clients around the world, including Fortune 100 enterprises and mid-market organizations, higher education institutions, municipality and local governments, and federal agencies. Known for its programmatic approach to continuously transforming cyber defense programs, DeepSeas is recognized by Gartner as a top 40 provider of MDR and ranked as a top 5 MDR leader in the 2024 Frost Radar™: Global Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Market. In addition to its industry-leading MDR service, DeepSeas offers a full suite of advisory, compliance, and testing services to support clients on their cybersecurity transformation journeys, with an approach to cyber defense that prioritizes technical expertise, tradecraft, and continuous innovation to deliver unparalleled results.
Position Summary
We're looking for (5) Senior SOC Analyst (L2) to drive the quality of outcomes in DeepSeas' client-facing detection and response.
You're a seasoned incident responder who leads high-severity investigations, mentors L1 and L2 analysts, and turns findings from threat hunting, malware analysis, and forensics into stronger detections and playbooks. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, deep technical aptitude, awareness of the evolving threat landscape, and strong operational execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads and mentors a team of L1 and L2 incident responders in handling security incidents.
  • Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders during high-severity incidents.
  • Develops, refines, and tests incident response playbooks and procedures.
  • Conducts advanced threat-hunting activities to detect sophisticated adversaries.
  • Collaborates with threat intelligence and vulnerability management teams to stay current on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Provides expert guidance in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
  • Develops and fine-tunes detection rules to enhance threat detection capabilities.
  • Uses frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to understand and categorize threat actor TTPs.
  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives within the SOC.
  • Generates metrics and reports on incident response activities and trends for leadership.
  • Conducts regular briefings to leadership on security incidents and trends.
  • Develops and maintains scripts to automate and enhance incident response processes.
  • Conducts in-depth malware analysis to determine malware samples' functionality, origin, and impact.
  • Collaborates with threat intelligence teams to correlate malware findings with known threat actor campaigns.
  • Provides recommendations to enhance detection and prevention capabilities based on malware analysis findings.
  • Leads digital forensics investigations, including memory forensics, to uncover evidence and artifacts related to security incidents.
  • Oversees network forensics activities to analyze network traffic logs and detect malicious activities or patterns.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert on incident response, providing guidance and advice to DeepSeas and client leadership.

Experience, Education, and Skills Required

Minimum Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or threat detection, including time operating at a senior (L3) level or leading investigations; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Proven experience leading high-severity incident response from triage through containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and SOAR platforms, including writing and tuning detection content (e.g., KQL, SPL, Sigma, YARA).
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and the incident response lifecycle (e.g., NIST SP 800-61).
  • Experience with host, memory, and network forensics, as well as static and dynamic malware analysis.
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate investigation and response tasks.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief both technical teams and executive or client audiences.
  • This position is open only to U.S. citizens who currently reside within the United States.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Advanced certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GREM, GNFA, OSCP, or CISSP.
  • Experience in an MDR or MSSP environment supporting multiple clients.
  • Familiarity with reverse engineering and memory forensics tools (e.g., Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg, Volatility).
  • Experience building or maturing a threat-hunting or detection engineering program.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.

Why DeepSeas?

At Deep Seas, we like to say that heart rates go down, careers take off, and security programs mature. Our values provide the ultimate guide for our daily behavior and decisions. Without these values, we aren’t Deep Seas. They preserve the essence of our organization, reflect the personalities of our Deeps (how we affectionately refer to our teammates), and enable us to exceed expectations. Our values are:
  • We are client obsessed.
  • We stand in solidarity with our teammates.
  • We prioritize personal health and well-being.
  • We believe in the power of diversity.
  • We solve hard problems at the speed of cyber.
This is your chance to join a supportive crew of teammates and an industry-leading organization that values opportunities for growth. If DeepSeas sounds like a good fit for you, send us your resume and let’s talk!

Information security is everyone’s responsibility:
  • Understanding and following DeepSeas’s information security policies and procedures.
  • Remaining vigilant and reporting any suspicious activity or possible weaknesses in DeepSeas’s information security.
  • Actively participating in DeepSeas’s efforts to maintain and improve information security.
  • DeepSeas considers this position is as Moderate Risk with a potential to view/access/download restricted/private client/internal data.
  • This information must be treated with sensitivity and in the most secure manner.
  • HR reserves the right to perform random background/drug screens to ensure the safety of client/DeepSeas data

Your Next Challenge

  • Assist the Human Resources Business Partner & Operations team with the planning and execution of practices, programs, and initiatives supporting employment practices, organizational development, employee engagement, recognition, retention, compliance, audit, immigration, work from home initiatives, and other HR practices.
  • Participate in and assist with department and cross-functional project work groups.

What You'll Need

Human Resources 

The HR team ensures that every aspect of the employee experience from recruiting to on-boarding, performance and leadership development, culture and inclusion is supported in line with our Leadership Principles by our team and workforce systems and operations.

There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame.
We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world.

Working at Getty Images

Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals.
We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work.
Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. We offer learning experiences ranging from leadership development, diversity and inclusion training, mentoring programs, a high potential program, and professional and skills development. We prioritize staying connected in our hybrid-working world and encourage participation in global morale events and local gatherings, as well as finding community in one or more of our Employee Resource Groups. Learning about our business is paramount, and our open and transparent culture means you’ll have direct access to experts and senior leaders via open forums, all hands, and content hours.
Getty Images believes that diversity is critical to our success in moving the world and is committed to creating an inclusive, mutually respectful environment that celebrates diversity. We seek to hire based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. Getty Images is an equal opportunity employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.

  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)

Additional requirements

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. raw.excerpt: As a Staff Engineer on our Anti-Fraud Engineering team, you'll take ownership of the systems that protect millions of RecargaPay users and merchants from fraud in real time.
raw.description:
As a Staff Engineer on our Anti-Fraud Engineering team, you'll take ownership of the systems that protect millions of RecargaPay users and merchants from fraud in real time. You'll design and evolve the low-latency decisioning platform that scores transactions, enforces fraud rules, and feeds signals back to risk models — all while keeping genuine payments fast and frictionless. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role at the intersection of backend engineering, risk, and compliance, where your technical decisions directly shape RecargaPay's loss rates and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture of real-time fraud-decisioning services that score transactions, logins, and account changes within tight latency budgets (sub-second SLAs).
  • Own the evolution of the fraud rules engine, including rule versioning and safe rollout (shadow/canary), and build tooling that lets Risk and Fraud Ops analysts test hypotheses without waiting on engineering.
  • Partner with Data Science to productionize fraud-detection models — building low-latency feature pipelines and serving infrastructure that keep model inputs fresh and auditable.
  • Design event-driven pipelines (Kafka) that stream transaction, device, and behavioral signals across services with strict ordering, idempotency, and exactly-once guarantees where required.
  • Build the audit trail and explainability layer behind every fraud decision, so outcomes can be reconstructed and defended to regulators, card networks, and dispute teams.
  • Mentor engineers across levels, championing best practices in coding, system design, and incident response within the fraud engineering chapter.
  • Solve technical problems of the highest scope, complexity, and ambiguity — often with incomplete signals and real financial exposure on the line.
  • Promote AI-assisted engineering practices within the squad, using tooling for code generation, automated refactoring, and technical documentation to raise team velocity.

Requirements

  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Track record of success in hands-on backend engineering roles, developing with Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and AWS.
  • Experience designing or operating real-time decisioning, scoring, or rules-engine systems under strict latency budgets.
  • Hands-on experience with fraud, risk, or trust & safety systems — e.g. transaction scoring, device fingerprinting, velocity/anomaly detection, or chargeback and dispute pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming data (Kafka), including ordering, idempotency, and exactly-once semantics.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems, Object-Oriented Programming, and Domain-Driven Design; familiarity with microservice architecture is a plus.
  • Ability to translate compliance and audit requirements (e.g. BACEN, LGPD, PCI-DSS) into resilient, explainable system design.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Proven ability to design complex distributed applications built for high performance, throughput, scalability, and reliability.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.

Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving, with a proactive approach to closing technical and process gaps before they turn into losses.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, capable of leading technical decisions with minimal supervision, even under financial and regulatory pressure.
  • Proven mentorship capabilities, fostering the growth of junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain fraud-engineering trade-offs to both technical peers and Risk/Compliance stakeholders.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity — fraud patterns shift constantly, and "done" is a moving target.
  • Demonstrated influence in shaping engineering practices and elevating team-wide technical standards.
  • Alignment with company values: ownership, excellence, adaptability, and innovation.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the Use of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

In this role, you won’t be pushing transactional software or cold-pitching products—you will serve as a respected Enrollment Advisor, guiding ambitious students and parents through one of the most critical journeys of their academic lives while earning an uncapped, performance-driven income.

Compensation:

  • On-Target Earnings: $70,000–$90,000+
    • Uncapped performance-based commission
  • Comprehensive Benefits:Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage

  • Maintain an organized sales pipeline and proactively move prospective families through each stage of the enrollment process

your tasks

4C (Certification for Climate, Conservation, and Communities) is a global certification scheme for sustainable coffee and cocoa. 4C certification focuses on good agricultural and management practices, including requirements on economic, social, and environmental conditions for coffee production and processing in order to establish credible, sustainable, and transparent supply chains. Independent certification bodies verify compliance with the 4C requirements. 4C was developed in a comprehensive and transparent multi-stakeholder process involving coffee/cocoa producers, trade and industry, as well as organizations from civil society around the world. 4C aims to move the entire coffee or cocoa sector towards sustainability practices. 4C operates in 25 countries and is one of the largest certification systems in the coffee sector.

Since 2020, the 4C System has evolved into a robust, benchmarked standard, defining clear social, environmental, and economic criteria. Alongside certification, we provide innovative solutions to help companies comply with global regulations and strengthen responsible supply chains in a changing world.

4C Services GmbH, the operator of 4C certification system, is seeking to recruit a highly motivated freelance auditor to conduct integrity assessments within the framework of the 4C Integrity Program.

Key activities:

  • Planning, preparing, and conducting 4C integrity assessments at certified 4C Units, Intermediary and Final Buyers of 4C certified coffee and Certification Bodies cooperation with 4C, with focus on:
    • Traceability
    • Social issues such as child labour, forced labour, fair and safe working conditions
    • Environmental issues such as deforestation, biodiversity and soil conservation, and pesticide use
  • General support to 4C System users in countries of East and West Africa, Asia, or Latin America regarding communication, meetings, translation of documents, etc.
  • Contribution to the continuous development of the 4C System and the 4C Integrity Program

your profile

  • A minimum of five years of professional experience in certification or quality assurance, auditing or verification; At least a Bachelor University degree and Agricultural production background
  • Audit experience with certification systems such as 4C, Rainforest Alliance, CAFÉ Practices, Global G.A.P
  • Experience in supply chains for agricultural products, preferably in the area of coffee and/or cocoa
  • High proficiency in English and relevant local languages when applicable (French, Spanish, Portuguese, or Vietnamese) (spoken and written). Additional languages are of advantage
  • Good knowledge of the relevant tools/ software (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and/or GIS or remote sensing-based software/application for risk assessment)
  • High willingness and availability to travel
  • High level of commitment, proficiency and assertiveness
  • Structured, accurate and independent working style
Important note:

4C Integrity Auditors must be completely independent and free of conflict of interest with 4C System Users ().
This means the 4C Integrity Auditor cannot be employed or contracted as a consultant by a Certification Body or any 4C System User operating in the coffee/cocoa sector at the same time as working as a 4C Integrity Auditor.

why us?

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Competitive compensation
  • Professional onboarding to help you have an ideal start with us
  • Close collaboration with our sister companies Meo Carbon Solutions, ISCC System GmbH, and GRAS Global Risk Assessment Services, giving you even more learning opportunities
  • The opportunity to work independently and shape processes

ready to join our team?

If this job offer has caught your interest, we are looking forward to receiving your full application. Please submit your application, including a cover letter, your CV, and important certificates and references as a pdf file, with your earliest possible starting date and salary expectations.

We are a company with equal opportunities for everyone and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, or any other criteria that are not a professional qualification for an open position.

raw.description:
Since our founding, Parity Homes has raised over $15 million — driven almost entirely by our CEO, who has built relationships with major donors, foundations, and community investors from the ground up. We are looking for someone to professionalize and systematize what we’ve built so we can grow in scale without that growth depending on one person.

We are looking for a Major Gifts & Development Associate who brings ambition, drive, and genuine relationship instincts to this work. Someone who is energized by the pursuit — identifying prospects, opening doors, building authentic relationships, and seeing major commitments through to close. Writing is a key part of this role, but it is a means to an end. The end is securing transformational funding from donors giving at the $2M–$5M level.

You will work closely with our CEO to drive major donor cultivation from research through close. You will think strategically, act proactively, and take ownership of the pipeline. You write because it moves people to invest in communities — not because you love formatting reports.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Research and profile major donors, foundations, and conference attendees in advance of CEO engagements — so every meeting is maximized.
  • Own the follow-up. Draft outreach emails, thank-you notes, and cultivation communications as the CEO, ensuring the right tone, timing, and next step.
  • Move donors through the cultivation pipeline — from initial contact to scheduled meeting to funded commitment.
  • Identify and track grant opportunities aligned with Parity’s mission and manage submission calendars end-to-end.
  • Write compelling grant proposals, letters of inquiry, donor reports, and major gift case statements.
  • Prepare the CEO for speaking engagements and conferences by building briefing materials that surface funding opportunities.
  • Maintain and update the donor CRM, ensuring the pipeline is always current and actionable.
  • Proactively surface new funding strategies and prospect ideas — you don’t wait to be told where to look.

Requirements

  • Experience in business development, nonprofit development, major gifts, or a donor-facing fundraising role — we care more about your track record than your title.
  • Demonstrated success writing grant proposals or major donor communications that resulted in funding.
  • Familiarity with donor cultivation strategy and the major gifts cycle.
  • Comfort operating as an extension of a CEO or senior leader — drafting in their voice, representing their brand, and owning the follow-through.
  • Experience working in a startup, early-stage organization, or resource-constrained environment is a genuine plus.
  • CRM experience (any platform) is helpful but not required.

Who You Are

  • You are scrappy and resourceful. You figure things out. You don’t wait for a system to exist, you build one.
  • You are relationship-oriented. You understand that major donors are people, not line items, and you know how to cultivate trust over time.
  • You are a strategic thinker. You don’t just execute tasks — you see the board and know which moves matter.
  • You are an excellent writer. Your words are clear, compelling, and calibrated to the reader — whether that’s a foundation program officer or a high-net-worth individual.
  • You are driven by outcomes. You want to land big asks and you measure your own success by impact, not activity.
  • You are mission-aligned. You care about equitable development, community ownership, and the kind of work Parity is doing — and that comes through in how you represent the organization.
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote, startup environment with limited hand-holding and high expectations.
  • You are energized by building something — you don’t need a fully developed infrastructure around you to do your best work.
  • You are drawn to organizations doing real, ground-level work and you want to be close to the mission, not at a remove from it.
  • You see writing as one of many tools in your repertoire — and the goal is always to move people toward meaningful investment.

Benefits

  • Fully remote, global
  • $1,500 - $1,800 monthly commensurate with experience
  • Generous PTO

You will connect authentically with diverse K-12 stakeholders and departments, keeping student success at the center of every conversation, while expanding the reach of engaging learning content to positively impact teachers and students across your territory.

  • Have direct, regular exposure to our executive leadership team during meetings to discuss specific deal strategies, introduce industry trends, and build support for district-specific initiatives.
  • Access a highly skilled team dedicated to supporting this book of business, alongside extensive support from our Learning & Enablement team.

About You:

  • 4+ years of experience as an Account Executive with demonstrated success hitting or exceeding large sales quotas and selling products to school districts in the K-12 EdTech space required.
  • Specifically experience selling curriculum, Assessment, Data warehouse, and/or MTSS in the K-12 EdTech market required.
  • A true prospector who is willing and able to build a book of business from scratch, with extensive experience in networking, prospecting, pipeline generation, and proven success forecasting business in the EdTech industry.
  • Well-versed in MEDDPICC sales methodology.
  • Possess proven success forecasting business in the EdTech industry.
  • Highly organized, adaptable to change, a fast learner who hits the ground running, maintaining high service standards, and consistently meeting established sales goals in an agile environment.
  • Demonstrated experience as a strategic territory manager with the executive presence to lead consultative district conversations, navigating multiple stakeholders, and engineering the right solution for each customer.
  • Excited by opportunities to connect face-to-face to meet with customers and prospects. Travel is estimated to be approximately 25% (likely a few times per quarter), depending on business and customer needs.
  • Experiencing using AI tools to drive greater efficiency and productivity
  • Legally authorized to work in the US.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check as part of our pre-employment process.

Why You’ll Love Working At Newsela:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical benefits with employer contribution to premiums and to HSA accounts. Additional benefits such as gym reimbursement, pet insurance, free access to the Calm app, Rocket Lawyer and more to help you stay healthy: mind, body, and soul.
  • Work From Home: We are a fully remote company. We provide a monthly tech stipend to support your WFH needs!
  • Supporting ALL Families: Inclusive benefits to support you and your family, including parental leave, fertility support, adoption, and more!
  • Financial Wellbeing: Invest in your future with our 401(k) plan, which includes a employer match to help you build long-term financial security.
  • Time Off: Flexible PTO, paid sick time off, company holidays plus winter break (Dec 24th - Jan 1st).
  • Professional Development: Newsela offers an annual learning and development allowance to employees to attend external training sessions, classes, workshops, conferences, and educational materials to foster professional growth within their current role and career aspirations at Newsela.
  • Make A Difference: No matter your role or department, the work you do each day helps share the future of education and improves the lives of students and teachers.

About Newsela:

Newsela is a leading education technology company dedicated to meaningful classroom learning for every student. We deliver integrated, AI-powered solutions designed to unlock student engagement, empower teachers, and drive meaningful learning outcomes. Our suite of products supports knowledge and skill development, writing practice, daily instruction, assessment, and data-informed decision-making across K–12 classrooms. Grounded in learning science research, Newsela’s solutions integrate content, assessment, and analytics to help educators track progress, understand student outcomes, and deliver high-impact instruction that supports every learner.

Why join Safeguard Global? 👀

We want to help you “work in any way” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀

Join us as an HR Services Manager and make an impact on a global scale!

The role in a nutshell:

We are looking for a China Content and Social Marketing Specialist to strengthen Safeguard Global’s brand presence among Chinese companies expanding internationally. Reporting to the APAC Marketing Lead, you will own the China content calendar and create engaging, locally relevant Chinese-language content across WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, the Safeguard Global website and other relevant channels. You will turn global workforce, employment, compliance and international expansion topics into clear, practical content for Chinese business and HR audiences. This is a hands-on role that goes beyond translation—you will localize global content, develop original market-relevant stories, manage channel strategy and use performance insights to improve content and engagement.

How you will make a difference:

  • Develop and manage the China content strategy and editorial calendar in line with business and marketing priorities.
  • Create and edit high-quality Chinese content, including thought leadership, regulatory updates, country guides, case studies, interviews, campaign content and social posts.
  • Monitor global employment, labour, payroll and regulatory developments and translate complex topics into clear, practical insights for Chinese audiences.
  • Manage and coordinate content across WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Zhihu, the corporate website and other relevant platforms, adapting content to each channel and audience.
  • Localize global content by adding relevant Chinese-market context, examples and perspectives rather than relying on direct translation.
  • Support partner campaigns, paid initiatives, events and sales-enablement activities with relevant content and communications.
  • Collaborate with internal subject-matter experts, marketing, sales and external partners to develop impactful content.
  • Ensure Chinese-language content meets Safeguard Global’s brand, messaging, quality and editorial standards.
  • Track content and social media performance and use insights to improve topics, formats and distribution.

What will give you an advantage:

  • 3–5 years’ experience in content marketing, social media, marketing communications, journalism or a related role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Business or a related field.
  • Native-level Simplified Chinese writing, editing and proofreading skills.
  • Hands-on experience creating content for WeChat and a strong understanding of the Chinese digital/social media landscape.
  • Ability to turn complex business, regulatory or technical topics into clear and engaging content.
  • Experience creating a range of content formats, including articles, social posts, case studies, interviews and campaign content.
  • Strong research, fact-checking and editorial skills.
  • Experience localizing global content for Chinese audiences and adapting content based on local market needs.
  • Working proficiency in English to collaborate with global teams and work with English-language source material.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Basic understanding of content performance metrics and social media analytics.
  • B2B or professional services experience preferred. Experience in HR services, global employment, payroll, compliance, SaaS or international business would be an advantage.

What you'll bring:

  • Excellent understanding of Chinese audiences, cultural nuances and platform behaviours.
  • Strong storytelling skills and the ability to make complex topics accessible and engaging.
  • Curiosity about global business, international workforce trends and overseas expansion.
  • Strong ownership, initiative and attention to detail.
  • Collaborative and adaptable approach, with the ability to work across regional and global teams.
  • Ability to balance creativity with accuracy, brand consistency and business objectives.
  • A results-focused mindset and interest in how content drives awareness, engagement, trust and demand.

Who we are and what we do:

Safeguard Global is….Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.

  • International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.

Job Description

Come join our team. We're rapidly expanding AI agents for Observability group and building a new generation of AI Agents designed to transform how enterprises investigate, respond to, and remediate critical incidents and alerts. Our mission is to reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) by orders of magnitude, turning reactive firefighting into proactive, intelligent automation.

The AI agents for Observability combines the intelligence of large language models, the predictive power of observability analytics, and the judgment of human incident commanders, all within a single governed process that runs on ServiceNow's enterprise-grade platform. This dramatically reduces the time and expertise required to triage a multi-service incident and enables organizations to maintain SLOs even as their infrastructure complexity grows.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Design and architect the next generation of intelligent incident and alert investigation and remediation systems, enabling enterprises to automate away toil and focus on innovation.
  • Drive the technical direction for assigned projects,defining architecture, design patterns, best practices and leveraging the latest AI/ML models for integrations.
  • Collaborate with product managers, other software engineers, UX Designers and security experts to build product features that meet business objectives and security standards.
  • Lead architecture reviews and technical decision-making on high-impact initiatives spanning multiple teams.
  • Create tools, libraries, and frameworks for other developers to build upon
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies and leverage them to drive innovation and improve our platform.
  • Mentor and influence engineering excellence across the incident intelligence domain, helping colleagues apply emerging agentic patterns responsibly.
  • 12+ years of experience building scalable software applications using Java or a similar object-oriented programming language
  • Strong experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern frontend engineering practices
  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and performance optimization
  • Proven expertise in multi-agent systems design: orchestration frameworks, agent communication patterns, state management across distributed agents.
  • Practical experience integrating foundation models and LLMs into production systems, with awareness of hallucination, latency, cost, and safety trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to solve significant technical problems with broad impact across teams or product areas
  • Demonstrated expertise in architecture, technical strategy, and driving complex initiatives from design through delivery
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering excellence through reviews, standards, and technical leadership
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools to improve development workflows and engineering productivity
  • Strong analytical and software design skills

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Associate Electrical Engineer-Federal Engineering & Design

Job Description

We are seeking an Associate Electrical Engineer to join our Federal Engineering and Design Team. In this role, you will support the planning and design of electrical systems for federal facilities and infrastructure projects. Working alongside experienced engineers and designers, you will gain exposure to federal design standards, including UFC, DoD, and VA requirements, while developing technical expertise in power distribution, lighting, communications, fire alarm, and other building electrical systems.

This position provides hands-on experience designing mission-critical facilities and offers the opportunity to contribute to projects that support national interests while building a strong foundation for your engineering career.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design of electrical systems for federal facilities, including power distribution, lighting, grounding, communications, and life safety systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations, system layouts, and equipment selections under the guidance of licensed engineers.
  • Develop and apply knowledge of electrical engineering principles, codes, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Utilize engineering and design software such as Revit, AutoCAD, or other electrical modeling and analysis tools.
  • Assist with project schedules, design coordination efforts, and interdisciplinary collaboration with mechanical, civil, structural, and architectural teams.
  • Research applicable federal design criteria and recommend solutions to technical challenges.
  • Gain experience creating and maintaining project information within the firm's project management systems.
  • May travel to project sites and federal installations to support design development, construction, and project coordination activities.

Why Join Us?

  • Contributes to projects that support national defense, public service, and critical federal infrastructure.
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements, including remote work options.
  • Grow your technical expertise through mentorship, professional development opportunities, and exposure to complex federal projects.
  • Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment that values teamwork, learning, and career growth.

Qualifications

You Are Passionate About:

  • Solving complex engineering challenges.
  • Working collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.
  • Building technical expertise and continuous learning.
  • Using your talents to positively impact communities and federal clients.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a concentration in power.
  • Minimum of one year of engineering experience, internship experience, or equivalent academic project experience.
  • Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain within a reasonable timeframe.
  • Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles related to building and facility systems.
  • Working knowledge of, or ability to become proficient in, design and modeling software such as Revit, AutoCAD, SKM, AGi32, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and electrical building systems is preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Willingness to travel and perform occasional field work as required.

Additional Information

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

As an Olsson employee, you will:

  • Receive a competitive 401(k) match
  • Be empowered to build your career with tailored development paths
  • Have the possibility for flexible work arrangements
  • Engage in work that has a positive impact on communities
  • Participate in a wellness program promoting balanced lifestyles

In addition, full-time employees will receive our traditional benefits package (health care, vision, dental, paid time off, etc.) and the opportunity to participate in a bonus system that rewards performance.

Olsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran, and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, military status, or other protected status.

Olsson understands the importance of privacy and is committed to protecting job applicants’ personal information. Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (collectively, the “CCPA”), this notice explains Olsson’s practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information for job applicants residing in California. Please read this Notice carefully to understand our privacy practices.

About us:

Founded in 2016, ELSA harnesses the power of generative AI to improve English communication skills globally with headquarters in San Francisco and offices in Lisbon, Tokyo, Jakarta, Singapore and Vietnam. With over 50 million users and 1 billion hours of anonymized data, our AI-driven language learning platform delivers hyper-personalized learning paths for both businesses and individuals, transforming lives and organizations through effective spoken English. ELSA is backed by leading investors including Gradient Ventures - Googles A.I. fund, Monk's Hill Ventures and Global Ventures.

Role & Responsibility:

We are seeking a highly experienced and driven Director of Data to join our rapidly growing Data Science team. In this role, you will:

  • Lead experimentation: Design and evaluate A/B tests, multivariate tests, and other causal frameworks to inform product and marketing decisions.
  • Build a culture of learning: Champion a test-and-learn mindset across the company and enable others to generate hypotheses and iterate rapidly.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, B2B, Finance, Growth, and Engineering to frame questions, prioritize analysis, and deliver clear, actionable insights.

  • Enable scale: Work hands-on with data pipelines, define experimentation frameworks, and contribute to analytics infrastructure.

Requirements:

  • 5-8+ years of experience in Data Science, Decision Science, or Analytics roles, ideally in consumer tech and SaaS.
  • Proven experience running and analyzing experiments at scale (A/B testing, Bayesian methods, uplift modeling, etc.).
  • Strong SQL and Python (or R) skills; comfort with data modeling and visualization (e.g., dbt, Looker, Mode, Tableau).
  • Deep understanding of statistics, causal inference, and hypothesis-driven analysis.
  • A storyteller: can distill complex data into simple, compelling narratives that drive action.
  • Prior leadership experience or readiness to build and lead a small but mighty team.
  • Bonus: exposure to product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Looker), marketing data, or growth analytics.
  • English proficiency.

Why join ELSA?

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Remote work.
  • Free ELSA Premium courses to polish your language skills.

raw.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

At Simply.TV, we're redefining how the world experiences TV metadata. As a leading provider of advanced, AI-driven metadata solutions, we empower broadcasters, streaming platforms, and telecom operators to deliver smarter, more engaging content discovery experiences. From next-gen EPG (Electronic Program Guide) data to rich content enrichment, we enable our partners to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving media landscape.

Whether you're passionate about media technology, data engineering, or product innovation, Simply.TV is the place to shape the future of TV — and have fun doing it.


For candidates based in Mexico!
As a Streaming Data & Operations Analyst, you will take ownership of technical and data-related issues affecting Simply.TV’s streaming services — from initial investigation through resolution.

This is an analytical and technically hands-on role for someone with a strong academic background in Computer Science, Data, or a closely related field, solid Python skills, and the ability to use AI tools and effective prompting as part of their problem-solving workflow.

You will investigate why streaming catalogs, feeds, or data processes are not working as expected, identify root causes, resolve issues where possible, and escalate more complex problems with a clear technical diagnosis.

You will work closely with Streaming, Development, Operations, and other technical teams while also communicating directly with clients when needed. This means you should be equally comfortable diving into data and technical problems as you are explaining your findings clearly to others.

This is not a traditional support role. We are looking for someone who is analytical, curious, technically confident, and able to take ownership of problems rather than simply follow established runbooks.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of streaming data issues from initial investigation through resolution.
  • Investigate incorrect catalogs, feeds, data anomalies, failed processes, and other streaming-related issues.
  • Identify root causes by analysing data, system behaviour, logs, feeds, and technical workflows.
  • Use Python to investigate, validate, manipulate, or troubleshoot data and technical processes.
  • Resolve issues independently where possible or escalate them to Development or other technical teams with a clear diagnosis and supporting information.
  • Work with structured data, APIs, logs, feeds, internal systems, and other technical sources.
  • Use AI tools and effective prompting to support analysis, investigation, troubleshooting, and productivity.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Communicate directly with clients regarding streaming-data issues, investigations, and resolutions.
  • Collaborate with Development, Operations, and Streaming teams to improve workflows and prevent recurring issues.
  • Manage multiple investigations and priorities while meeting deadlines and SLA requirements.
  • Document findings, solutions, and recurring problems to improve team knowledge and processes.
  • Continuously develop your understanding of Simply.TV’s streaming products, data architecture, and technical workflows.

Practicalities

  • Reports to: Head of Streaming
  • Employment Type: Full-time contractor
  • Location: Mexico
  • Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, IT, or a closely related technical field.
  • Solid practical Python skills and confidence using Python for data analysis, investigation, automation, or troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate an issue and identify its root cause.
  • Good understanding of data structures, technical systems, and how data moves between different systems or processes.
  • Experience using AI tools effectively, including strong prompting skills for research, analysis, troubleshooting, or productivity.
  • Ability to work independently on technical problems and take ownership from investigation through resolution.
  • Ability to understand technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple investigations or priorities simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change.

Nice-to-haves

  • Previous experience in data analytics, data operations, technical support, technical operations, QA, or a similar analytical role.
  • Experience working with APIs, JSON/XML, databases, SQL, logs, scripting, or data pipelines.
  • Experience with streaming technologies, OTT platforms, broadcasting, media technology, metadata, or digital content.
  • Previous experience working with client-facing technical issues.
  • Experience using Python for automation or building small internal tools.
  • Familiarity with debugging technical workflows and identifying issues across multiple systems.
  • Previous experience in an international or cross-functional environment.

Previous experience in television or streaming is helpful but not required. Strong technical fundamentals, analytical thinking, Python skills, and the ability to learn complex systems are more important.

Benefits

Compensation: $2,000–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and technical skill level, based on a full-time contractor setup.

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a leader in diagnostics, drug development and healthcare innovation. Across every role, we harness data and AI to work smarter, move faster and create breakthrough solutions that improve health outcomes for people. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact. Together, we're improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Principal, Clinical Translation and Scientific Engagement Lead, Real World Data to join our team remotely in Poland.


Work Schedule:

This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position with standard business hours in your time zone, Monday through Friday. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.


Main Responsibilities:


Strategic leadership & execution

  • Work with Global Head RWD Data strategy & technical solutions, as well as the wider RWD team, to understand shifts in RWD requirements and their implications to current strategy and product roadmap.
  • Contribute to product roadmap by identifying potential use cases and requirements to address shifts in technology and clinical practice.
  • Keep current with and appropriately evaluate the medical literature, guidelines, and other clinical information sources to identify relevant shifts in key shifts in medical practice and guidance that may drive shifts in RWD requirements.
  • Stay informed of shifts in technology (including use of AI technologies) to support clinical interpretation and how this is impacting data generation, clinical analyses and interpretation.

Clinical translation

  • Provide subject matter expertise in defining and translating clinical concepts/requirements into data definitions.
  • Collaborate with technical and business leaders in RWD to enhance and refine our solutions based on clinical experience and shifts in clinical practice.
  • Work with Technical teams to define key analyses to confirm scientific and clinical accuracy and appropriateness of Labcorp RWD Data and solutions, and consistency with existing scientific evidence base.
  • Work with Labcorp clinical and scientific experts, as needed, to refine data definitions, analyses and interpretation of findings from Labcorp RWD data and solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI solutions to enhance clinical translation.

Operational excellence

  • Serve as the primary resource for cohort and feature definition and clinical inquiries within the RWD team.
  • Identify and engage other clinical and scientific experts within Labcorp to provide timely input as needed.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance engagement, patient satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify and lead efforts to implement AI solutions to support clinical aspect of data and product workflows, collaborating with other teams (including Technical, Compliance and data governance) to ensure consistency and compliance of implementation and development of KPIs and guardrails to track performance and impact.
  • Ensure timely input and resolution of clinical enquiries within data and product development and delivery.

Partner management

  • Work with Global Head RWD Data strategy and technical partnership to establish relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare practitioners, academic institutions and industry personnel.
  • Build and develop relationships with clinical leaders within Labcorp to test and refine use cases & clinical definitions and test & validate emerging findings.
  • Confidently and credibly present use cases, definitions and RWD content / interpretations by leading presentations, and demonstrations to both internal and external stakeholders.

Scientific and clinical leadership

  • Work with BD and Marketing to identify clinical events / congresses where Labcorp/RWD could attend.
  • Contribute to congress and publication strategy to support elevation of Labcorp RWD scientific and clinical leadership.
  • Collaborate with RWD analytics teams to identify and develop insights for external communication in publications and at scientific congresses.
  • Attend key congresses, to present finding and support RWD colleagues in engaging clinical leaders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Healthcare professional degree (e.g., MD, PharmD) with 3 or more years of clinical practice.
  • 2 or more years of experience in RWD/RWE and/or healthcare analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Post graduate research experience in Life sciences (e.g. Masters, PhD)
  • Demonstrable experience in publication of scientific research and/or presentation at medical congresses on topics related to RWD/E

Additional Job Standards:

  • Knowledge and understanding about real world data and the life science/healthcare industry.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and data privacy laws and best practices.
  • Deep understanding in key medical coding ontologies (e.g., ICD-10, NDC RxNorm
  • Knowledge and experience in leveraging AI tools to support data generation, interpretation and validation activities
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional environment including with clinical, business, and technical teams as well as external partners/collaborators.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong planning, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Critical thinking and sound decision making.
  • High level of persistence, professionalism, and positive attitude.

Working conditions

Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Limited (10-20%) travel may be required based on partner needs and business priorities.


About the role:

The Clinical translation and scientific engagement lead, Real-world data plays a vital role translating clinical concepts into technical definitions to enable data curation and analysis. This position will serve as the key point of clinical expertise within the RWD to support development of data products & solutions.

Internally, the position will directly support technical and business teams to develop and refine definitions, approaches and interpretation within RWD/E. The position is also responsible for engaging Labcorp SME’s on clinical topics relevant to RWD to further enhance the RWD teams operational work and strategic planning.

This role will also work with RWD leads in Labcorp to build relationships with external clinical experts as well as contributing to efforts to enhance Labcorp’s scientific leadership through supporting team in planning, writing, submission and presentation of abstracts and publications to congresses and conferences.

LOCATION: Remote/hybrid. Candidates within commuting distance of a Wolters Kluwer office will be considered for hybrid employment. Candidates not within commuting distances will be considered for remote employment.


OVERVIEW


Wolters Kluwer, UpToDate® and Lexidrug® is seeking experienced clinicians to join our team as Clinical Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategists. This role is central to shaping the future of trustworthy, clinically intelligent AI systems and ensuring that our clinical content and solutions are developed and deployed in ways that preserve clinical accuracy, quality, and trust.


You will work cross-functionally across Clinical AI, Product, Engineering, Editorial, and Business Development to develop and continuously improve our clinical AI solutions and support their implementation with strategic partners and customers. You will bring strong clinical expertise, academic and research experience, and exceptional communication skills to help advance our solutions, guide their clinically appropriate deployment, and represent Wolters Kluwer’s approach to trustworthy clinical decision support.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Clinical AI Strategy & Development

  • Collaborate on cross-functional teams to design, refine, validate, and continuously improve clinical AI systems and clinical decision support solutions.
  • Contribute clinical expertise to clinical reasoning frameworks, decision pathways, evaluation approaches, and other methodologies that reflect real-world clinical decision making.
  • Lead and contribute to clinical validation activities, including clinical test sets and benchmarks, safety evaluation, and expert testing to ensure outputs are clinically accurate, faithful, and meaningful.
  • Translate clinician, customer, and partner feedback into system improvements, working closely with Product, Engineering, Editorial, and Clinical AI teams.
  • Monitor developments in clinical AI, evidence-based medicine, regulatory frameworks, and risk management relevant to trustworthy clinical AI.

Strategic Partnerships & Clinical Deployment

  • Partner closely with Business Development and cross-functional teams as a clinical representative of Clinical AI in strategic partner and customer engagements.
  • Communicate Wolters Kluwer’s approach to clinical accuracy, quality, safety, and trustworthy clinical AI, including the safeguards and methodologies used in the development and deployment of our solutions.
  • Provide clinical guidance throughout partner and customer implementations, helping ensure our content and solutions are integrated and deployed in clinically appropriate ways.
  • Review implementations of our clinical content and solutions within partner and customer platforms from a clinical perspective and contribute to required approval and sign-off processes.
  • Work with partners, customers, and internal teams to design and execute clinical outcomes studies that evaluate the impact of integrating Wolters Kluwer solutions into clinical workflows.
  • Represent Wolters Kluwer through clinical thought leadership activities, including conference presentations, roundtable discussions, client presentations, interviews, publications, and case studies.

Clinical Practice (optional – up to 20%)

Clinicians may allocate time to maintain active clinical practice, ensuring continued relevance and real-world insight; existing clinical stipend for physician editors will continue to apply.


QUALIFICATIONS


Education

  • MD, DO, PharmD, Advanced Practice Provider, or equivalent clinical degree.

Experience

raw.excerpt: We're looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer to lead the user experience strategy and design direction for our mission-critical control room software programme.
raw.description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer to lead the user experience strategy and design direction for our mission-critical control room software programme. Used by emergency services and public safety organisations, the platform supports incident management, resource coordination and operational decision-making in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.

Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, customers and stakeholders, you'll balance user needs, operational requirements, technical constraints and business goals. You'll combine hands-on design delivery with design leadership, establishing a clear UX roadmap and ensuring multiple Scrum teams can deliver against a shared experience vision.

As the senior designer on the programme, you'll provide leadership, support and constructive challenge to other designers while helping shape effective ways of working, reusable design patterns and design system adoption. You'll balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term experience improvements, ensuring design quality remains high as the programme evolves.

While embedded within the Public Safety team, you'll also be part of NEC Digital Studio's Product Design practice, working alongside UX designers, interaction designers, service designers and user researchers. You'll benefit from a strong user-centred design community while helping improve standards, best practice and consistency across our design approaches and systems.

What You'll Be Doing

UX Strategy, Planning & Delivery

  • Lead the UX strategy and design direction for the control room programme, developing and maintaining a roadmap aligned to user needs, product priorities, technical dependencies and delivery plans.
  • Plan and coordinate design activity across multiple Scrum teams, ensuring work is prioritised, evidenced and ready to support delivery at pace.
  • Anticipate upcoming design requirements, identify risks, dependencies and opportunities, and help inform prioritisation decisions.
  • Continuously improve design processes, ways of working and team efficiency while maintaining high standards of design quality.

Design Leadership

  • Provide leadership, support, critique and mentoring to designers across the programme, helping establish effective ways of working and a coherent user experience.
  • Advocate for user-centred design, helping increase UX maturity across teams and disciplines through coaching, collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  • Establish practical standards, principles and design patterns that enable consistent delivery at scale.
  • Act as an escalation point for design quality, consistency and delivery risks.

Hands-On UX Design

  • Lead and contribute directly to the design of complex user journeys, workflows and interactions, producing high-quality wireframes, prototypes and implementation-ready designs.
  • Apply research, accessibility requirements, analytics and delivery constraints to inform and iterate design solutions.
  • Evaluate alternative approaches, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure effective use of design systems, reusable components and established patterns.
  • Create and maintain design documentation to support collaboration and successful implementation.

Research & Evidence

  • Independently plan, conduct and synthesise user research and usability testing activities, while collaborating with specialist researchers where appropriate.
  • Use evidence and insights to shape design direction, challenge assumptions, reduce risk and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate research findings into actionable design recommendations, product decisions and roadmap priorities.
  • Communicate design rationale clearly through evidence, user needs and measurable outcomes.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with customers, stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams, facilitating workshops and collaborative design activities.
  • Challenge requirements constructively, helping teams balance user needs, operational realities, technical constraints and business goals.
  • Communicate design rationale, risks, opportunities and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Accessibility & Best Practice

  • Champion accessibility, usability and inclusive design throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Work closely with engineers to ensure design intent is delivered effectively and contribute to the evolution of design systems and best practices across the organisation.

Essential

  • Must be eligible for UK Security Clearance
  • Significant experience designing complex enterprise, case management, operational or internal digital products, with a portfolio demonstrating measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading and supporting UX or Product Designers, while coordinating design activity across multiple delivery teams or workstreams.
  • Ability to develop and maintain a UX roadmap, ensuring design activity is planned and prioritised to support product objectives and delivery at pace.
  • Strong hands-on user-centred design experience, with the ability to personally deliver high-quality user journeys, interaction designs, wireframes, prototypes and production-ready designs, while using research and evidence to inform design decisions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation and communication skills, with confidence challenging assumptions and guiding evidence-led decision making.
  • Experience working effectively within multidisciplinary teams, balancing user needs, operational realities, technical feasibility and delivery constraints.
  • Strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive design, and experience designing within regulatory, compliance-driven or policy-driven environments.
  • Experience owning, evolving and applying design systems (including Material UI), reusable components and design patterns to support consistency, scalability and efficient delivery.

Desirable

  • Experience working with public safety, emergency services, policing, fire, ambulance, justice or similarly complex operational environments.
  • Experience designing products that span multiple screens, user roles, workflows or interconnected systems, maintaining a coherent experience across complex journeys.
  • Experience working with and integrating established industry design systems (for example Material Design, Human Interface Guidelines or similar) alongside organisation-specific design systems.
  • Experience using AI-powered design, research or prototyping tools appropriately to improve efficiency while maintaining design quality and user-centred decision-making.
  • Experience designing AI-enabled product experiences, understanding where AI can add value to users and where more traditional interaction patterns may be more appropriate.
